notes.title: New Locations, New Laboratory, New Features – More Survival!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Community,[/h2][p]I am very happy to present to you a [b]big new update[/b] for my game!
This update includes numerous [b]improvements, expansions, revisions, and bug fixes[/b].[/p][p]My goal is to continuously improve the gameplay experience, and I hope you enjoy this update and that it might even lead to new, positive reviews. As a [b]solo developer[/b], I work on this project with a lot of passion and try to implement your feedback as best as I can.[/p][p]I want to turn things around once more, and every [b]review and every comment[/b] really counts. They help me to set the right priorities and develop new ideas.[/p][p]I am also especially excited about new [b]videos of the game[/b]! If any of you create content, feel free to share it. Great videos I can feature here in the news or even embed them as recordings on the Steam page, including a link to your YouTube channel. Everything that helps make the game more known is very welcome.[/p][p]Thank you very much for your support and your feedback, I am really looking forward to your opinions on the update![/p][p][/p][h3]New Location: The Laboratory[/h3][p]One of the highlights of this update is the new area [b]“The Laboratory”[/b], which completes the story of [i]KeepUp Survival[/i] and provides answers to what really happened on this island.[/p][p]My game is deliberately not designed like every other survival game. Instead, it is meant to spark your imagination and give you space to form your own picture of what lies behind the island.[/p][p]The focus remains on [b]adventure, base building, and exploration[/b], not on classic zombie or enemy combat. The game should always preserve its own unique style and atmosphere.[/p][p]For those who still want some action with the undead, there is a [b]free Zombie DLC[/b]. This is intended as an extra to cater to different tastes, without detracting from the original vision and the core of the main game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/c995c8251a79e52e615aac11f5564a0fd25aaab4.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Multi-Deck Pro[/h3][p]Another major update is the complete overhaul of the old map overview. It has been removed and replaced with the new [b]Multi-Deck system[/b].[/p][p]The Multi-Deck not only shows you the map but also encourages you to explore more actively. You no longer see everything the island has to offer right away; instead, you now need to craft [b]markers[/b] to mark important locations and find them again later. This is intended to keep the game more exciting and interesting in the long run.[/p][p]In addition, the Multi-Deck now provides other helpful information such as:[/p][list][*][p]Map overview[/p][/*][*][p]Time[/p][/*][*][p]Weather[/p][/*][*][p]Day progress[/p][/*][*][p]Flashlight[/p][/*][/list][p]Along with this change, the previous display of this information in the [b]HUD[/b] has been removed and fully integrated into the [b]Multi-Deck[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/47db95cd94ad92b73b9128b1349b6c81091ba243.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Tape Recordings[/h3][p]From now on, you can find [b]tape recordings[/b] on the island that reveal small pieces of information and background details.[/p][p]A special feature: the voices were recorded by my little daughter. I think she did a great job, even if we won’t be winning an Oscar with it 😉 I’m very proud of her and hope this addition brings you as much joy as it does to me.[/p][p]If you like the idea and would enjoy discovering more of these recordings in the game, let me know, there could be more coming in the future![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/3601b970a175e19cd3d3cd6754fac6891bfd9112.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]New Vehicle[/h3][p]From now on, there is a [b]new vehicle[/b] in the game – more agile, sportier, and overall easier to handle.[/p][p]The old buggy, which received a lot of criticism, has been removed and directly replaced with the new one. Players who already owned a buggy don’t need to do anything – it has automatically been swapped for the new model.[/p][p]In the future, there will be further updates to make the vehicle available for [b]multiplayer[/b] as well.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/da2e1c979f757d1313713674f0a697d8a6c81178.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Castle Update[/h3][p]Several improvements have been made to the [b]castle[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]A collision issue that blocked passage was removed.[/p][/*][*][p]The stairs were adjusted, making going up and down much smoother.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug where animals could not move near the castle has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]6 PM Bells[/b][/p][p]As a small extra, the [b]castle bells[/b] now ring every day at [b]6 PM[/b]. The sound can be heard across most of the map, adding a special atmosphere to the island – and it also carries its own meaning.[/p][p][/p][h3]Weather Effects[/h3][p]With this update, the weather has an even greater impact on your gameplay experience:[/p][list][*][p]In [b]cold conditions[/b], frosty effects appear around the edges of the screen, enhancing the feeling of an icy environment.[/p][/*][*][p]During [b]rain[/b], the screen visually appears wet, making you feel right in the middle of the storm.[/p][/*][/list][p]These small details are designed to make the [b]atmosphere and immersion[/b] even more intense.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/633cdf5e6739e90adf331265714c3ed1db0cbd30.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Trophies[/h3][p]From now on, you can also find [b]trophies[/b] in the game – such as [b]skeleton heads[/b] or even a [b]special weapon[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/b3f6b8e40ff8ae35db35592ab25060be936666f7.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Loot Update[/h3][p]On [b]Lost Island[/b], all previously lootable vehicles have been replaced with new models. This now gives you a greater variety of vehicles to search through.[/p][p]In addition, you can now also find loot at specific objects – for example, [b]electronic parts[/b] can be discovered at the [b]tractor[/b]. This makes exploring the island even more diverse and rewarding.[/p][p][/p][p]⚠️ [b]Note on Loot and Savegames[/b][/p][p]In existing savegames, it may happen that the [b]newly added loot objects[/b] are not visible. This mainly concerns the usual loot, but also includes some [b]new trophies[/b].[/p][p]I am currently working on a solution for this issue and will inform you as soon as an update is available.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/b07962697a670a26369b6853b7eef01fc2078e8d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/0f324fd6b5497950454d90e3759ab851b2e9af0d.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Camps[/h3][p]On [b]Lost Island[/b], there used to be small camps known as [b]Safe Zones[/b]. These have now been thoroughly reworked:[/p][list][*][p]No longer usable as Safe Zones.[/p][/*][*][p]You can still set your [b]respawn point[/b] there as usual.[/p][/*][*][p]The camps have been [b]visually redesigned[/b] and now appear more atmospheric and varied.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/9fa02b56da4bb82f44b1ba325ea04517c54b22b8.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Character Update[/h3][p]The character has been reworked to make the gameplay feel more dynamic:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]attack animation[/b] has been improved and is now executed faster.[/p][/*][*][p]A matching [b]sound effect[/b] has been added, making the action feel even more impactful.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Crafting[/h3][list][*][p]The [b]heat lamp[/b] and the [b]UV lamp[/b] have had their brightness adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Both lamps have also received a [b]new look[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]crafting menu[/b], you can now also find the [b]Multi-Deck[/b] and [b]markers[/b], which you can craft yourself.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/03a0c30f812dc54901e215fba28ad6b6bee5a3c0.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Street Lamps[/h3][p]The [b]street lamps[/b], as well as smaller lamps that automatically turn on and off depending on the time of day, have been reworked and improved.[/p][p][/p][h3]Optimizations[/h3][p]Numerous additional [b]optimizations[/b] have been made to improve performance. As some of you may have noticed, performance on [b]Lost Island[/b] is not yet as good as on the other maps. However, it’s important to me to ensure better support for [b]older hardware[/b] as well.[/p][list][*][p][b]Trees and bushes[/b] have been adjusted with sharper LODs to improve performance, especially on weaker systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional adjustments have been made to reduce the load on [b]CPU and GPU[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Recommended Settings[/b][/p][list][*][p]For current hardware: use [b]DX12[/b] and [b]TSR[/b] as usual.[/p][/*][*][p]For older hardware: [b]TAA[/b] is recommended, and you may also try starting with [b]DX11[/b] for better results.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Time & Date[/h3][p]Due to an issue with date management, several adjustments have been made.
From now on, the [b]date will be correctly saved and loaded[/b], ensuring that the [b]seasons[/b] work properly again. This means you can once more fully experience the change between [b]summer and winter[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Note:[/b] In existing savegames, the [b]days may be displayed incorrectly[/b]. This issue only affects old savegames and has no impact on gameplay.
All [b]newly created savegames[/b] work as intended and display the date and days correctly.[/p][p][/p][h3]Items[/h3][list][*][p]The description of [b]“Cooking Meat”[/b] was incorrect and has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]In upcoming updates, further [b]language versions[/b] will be updated to improve localization.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Controller[/h3][p]A problem when [b]driving with the controller[/b] has been fixed:[/p][list][*][p]The controller previously did not respond to [b]accelerating or braking[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]This behavior has now been corrected.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Sounds & Music[/h3][p]The [b]background music[/b] on [b]Lost Island[/b] and the [b]Mountain Map[/b] has been renewed and now fits the game’s atmosphere even better.[/p][p]In addition, several [b]sound effects[/b] have been reworked, such as those for [b]doors[/b] and [b]vehicles[/b], to make the gameplay experience more immersive and cohesive.[/p][p][/p][h3]Main Menu[/h3][p]The [b]main menu[/b] has been updated with new background music that better matches the mood of the game.[/p][p]Under the [b]Info[/b] button, you will now find two new entries:[/p][list][*][p][b]Franchise[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Latest Update[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Clicking on these will open the respective [b]Steam Overlay[/b] directly, allowing you to view the content quickly, without needing to open a launcher or browser.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/07333b905848754325e1363ca636e50dc65970a3.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Game Menu[/h3][list][*][p]From now on, you have [b]quicker access[/b] to the [b]“Skip Night”[/b] function in the game menu. A confirmation prompt has been added to ensure you don’t accidentally skip the night.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]When using the [b]teleport function[/b] (e.g., if you ever get stuck), a confirmation prompt will now also appear.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Note:[/b] The game menu is [b]not a pause menu[/b] – the game world continues running in the background![/p][p][/p][h3]Guide Map[/h3][p]The [b]Guide Map[/b] was originally intended to help new players get started in the game. In practice, however, it often turned out to be the [b]first and only impression[/b] players had of the game. Many only tried this map and then decided whether to keep the game – which was also reflected in very short playtimes and refund requests.[/p][p]My goal, however, is for players to experience the game in its full depth and make their decision based on the [b]actual gameplay[/b]. For this reason, the Guide Map has been [b]temporarily disabled[/b].[/p][p]In parallel, I am working on a [b]new solution[/b] that will still make it easier for newcomers to get started, without reducing the entire game experience to a single map. This way, the first impression will be [b]fairer, more exciting, and closer to the core of the game[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3]Admin Tool (Beta)[/h3][p]The [b]Admin Tool[/b] was available in the game for several months on a trial basis. After careful consideration and on the recommendation of many players, I have decided to remove it.[/p][p]The reason is simple: the tool distorts the true [b]survival experience[/b] and ultimately takes away motivation, since it allowed players to spawn almost everything. Especially in a survival game, this is not beneficial and can quickly lead to boredom.[/p][list][*][p]Important: The [b]“Skip Night”[/b] feature will, of course, remain in the game![/p][/*][/list][p]I am aware that some of you may miss the Admin Tool. Nevertheless, I hope you can understand my decision and see that this is the right step for the game in the long run.[/p][p][/p][p]A big thank you to everyone who helped me with their feedback in making this decision![/p][p][/p][h3]Zombie (Beta) DLC[/h3][list][*][p]Zombies have been improved: they are now [b]faster[/b] and deal [b]more damage[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]running animation[/b] of the zombies has been reworked.[/p][/*][*][p]Work on improvements will continue – please keep in mind that this DLC is still in [b]beta[/b] and needs further polishing here and there.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Tropical Island DLC[/h3][list][*][p]Minor [b]optimizations[/b] made.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camps[/b] adjusted.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Red Desert DLC[/h3][list][*][p]Minor [b]optimizations[/b] made.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camps[/b] adjusted.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Mountain Map DLC[/h3][list][*][p]Minor [b]optimizations[/b] made.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camps[/b] adjusted.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Supporter Pack DLC[/h3][p]The [b]Supporter Pack[/b] is intended for all players who wish to further support the development of [i]KeepUp Survival[/i].
It provides [b]no gameplay advantages[/b], only [b]cosmetic content[/b].[/p][p]A heartfelt thank you to everyone who purchases this pack – your support greatly helps me to continue developing the game! ❤️[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4046130/KeepUp_Survival__Supporter_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]General Fixes[/b][/p][p]Various smaller bugs have been fixed to improve the gameplay experience and stability.[/p][p]If you have any questions or feedback, let me know! Thank you for your support and have fun with the game!

notes.title: Upcoming Update in KeepUp Survival – Secrets Await You!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Community,[/h1][p][/p][p]A new update for [b]KeepUp Survival[/b] will be released soon, introducing some exciting new additions.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Laboratory – The Story of the Island[/b]
A new laboratory gives you the opportunity to explore the background of the island. You can discover how the island became uninhabited and what the excavations in the ruins are about. Step by step, you will unravel the story of the island yourself.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Secret Rewards for Explorers[/b]
In the world of [b]KeepUp Survival[/b], unique items await, which cannot be crafted, but only found. Some of them are trophies, while others remain a mystery. Only those who look closely and explore thoroughly will discover them.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Overhauled Military Base and Changes in the Ruins[/b] The military base and the ruins are also receiving adjustments, making exploration even more rewarding. New surprises await in places you may already know or places you have yet to discover.[/p][p][/p][p]This update is meant to bring you closer to the [b]secrets and story of KeepUp Survival[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/1f25f55a40d41609432cf34879f1e0e61aeecfd4.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/264aee71e06da86486948ace5e79e42d190fc722.png"][/img][/p][p]In Discord you have the possibility to follow the development and ask questions. [url="https://discord.gg/8zyKXj9SDr"]https://discord.gg/8zyKXj9SDr[/url] [/p]

notes.title: Thank you, Community – almost 700 reviews!
notes.content: [h1][b]Hello Community,[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I just want to take a moment today to thank you. Every day I see how many of you are playing KeepUp Survival, giving feedback, and supporting me with ideas or bug reports.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Your Support[/b][/h3][p][b]Without you, the project would never have reached this point[/b], you are the reason why I keep going. Your feedback on Discord and in the Community Hub on Steam helps me enormously to further develop the game and improve it step by step.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]A Milestone[/b][/h3][p]And the great thing is: we are now approaching [b]700 reviews[/b], for me as an indie developer, this is incredibly impressive. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Many thanks to everyone who has already shared their review[/b], it helps KeepUp Survival tremendously![/p][p]If you enjoy KeepUp Survival, I look forward to reading your voice in the upcoming reviews as well. ❤️[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Thank you, survivors.[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/264aee71e06da86486948ace5e79e42d190fc722.png"][/img][/p][p]In Discord you have the possibility to follow the development and ask questions. [url="https://discord.gg/8zyKXj9SDr"]https://discord.gg/8zyKXj9SDr[/url] [/p]

notes.title: Fixes, Improvements, and Bug Corrections
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Community,[/h2][p]I have just released a new update.[/p][p][/p][p]This update contains corrections and bug fixes. Apparently, an error slipped in during June, which, as mentioned in the last update, was unfortunately only discovered now.[/p][p]This update also includes some minor fixes from the previous update.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1524630/view/563632115450643009"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Agriculture:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Some improvements have been made: From now on, your plants will receive water again when it rains. Make sure there are no trees or roofs above them.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]If you are using a roof, please ensure that the plants receive water, for example from a sprinkler, in addition to sufficient sunlight.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weapons:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The weapons have been updated several times recently, and the accuracy has now been slightly readjusted, as there was previously a small deviation.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]In the last update, I added a camera movement effect to make firing weapons feel more realistic. This effect has now been slightly toned down, as it felt a bit too strong after multiple tests.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weather:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The issue where rain or snowfall was no longer visually displayed has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]General Fixes[/b][/p][p]Various smaller bugs have been fixed to improve the gameplay experience and stability.[/p][p]If you have any questions or feedback, let me know! Thank you for your support and have fun with the game!

notes.title: Weapons, Farming and Building
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Community,[/h2][p]I have just released a new update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Farming:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Due to a change in a June update, a problem had occurred, which I only noticed now because someone reported it to me. The sprinkler did not transfer water to the plants; this problem has now been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Previously, only untreated water could be added. Now treated water can also be added, and when you look at the plant, the total number of bottles you have in your inventory will be displayed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Paraglider:[/b][/p][list][*][p]From now on, you can fly faster and further.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Most fans will now carry you higher than usual, allowing you to cover longer distances with the glider.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Vehicles:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cars, horses, and helicopters are now marked on the map to show their position, making them easier to find again.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weapons:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tools, one-handed weapons like the pickaxe or the shovel now have improved animation stops when striking.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapons now deal slightly more damage.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapons now cause a slight camera movement when striking.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Animals:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Occasionally, the animal would disappear after being killed. This problem has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Building:[/b][/p][list][*][p]From now on, you can build and install your own Updraft Vent. Keep in mind that it also requires its own power.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/4f37bd341b7d95c3c2764dc3f243da5b5f04191d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/a0bec8e67bb94d39e5959c16e2b53a18b3025859.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Bug:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Currently, there is an error with the weather; rain and snow are not displayed correctly. This problem also seems to have occurred with the June update. This problem is still being worked on.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]General Fixes[/b][/p][p]Various smaller bugs have been fixed to improve the gameplay experience and stability.[/p][p]If you have any questions or feedback, let me know! Thank you for your support and have fun with the game!

notes.title: Animals, Weapons and Balance – Your Feedback in Action!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Community,[/h2][p]I have just released a new update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]First of all, I would like to thank you for your feedback[/b] over the past few days here on Steam and Discord.[/p][p]Above all, the animals were often the main focus, as well as the first-person view, which was not very well received.[/p][p][b]Based on your feedback and suggestions[/b], I worked as quickly as possible to fix these issues. The first-person view and weapon handling were quickly improved in the last update. The animals have also been revised.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1524630/view/512965256196129977"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Another community comment was that there is too much food in the world. That’s why I made a few small adjustments. I have to proceed carefully here, as it takes time to achieve a good balance.[/p][p]This update includes further improvements over the previous update and brings a small but important change. [b]I hope you enjoy the update![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Character:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Currently, the damage taken is displayed on the screen. Now there is also a slight camera movement when you take damage, giving the impression that you actually got hurt.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weapons:[/b][/p][list][*][p]With one-handed weapons, the animations when hitting an object such as a tree or rock were not stopped in the first-person view. This has been fixed with this update.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The damage of some melee weapons, such as the stone axe, has been increased to balance the changes with the animals.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Animals:[/b][/p][list][*][p]All animals have now been further refined, especially their health status has been increased so that they do not die too quickly.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Another visual issue with the animals has been fixed. When turning away from the animals, some functions were restricted in order to improve performance. This caused the animal to be displayed too late when turning back, and the player was either already bitten or the animal had disappeared. This has now been changed and improved.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Further animation issues have been fixed, especially with the wolf, which tended to show strange animations. This has now been further improved – for example, you can now see the wolves howling.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Now to an important point that many of you mentioned.[/b] The animals were too easy to kill and caused little damage. From now on, caution is advised, because as mentioned, all animals now have a higher health level. Wolves are now the most dangerous enemies on the map. They appear in packs or alone and deal more damage than before. The damage varies depending on where the animal hits you. Since the wolf no longer only bites but also jumps while biting, the chance of taking significant damage is very high. The bear, on the other hand, is slow, but if it hits you, you suffer massive damage that can lead to instant death.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Escape behavior has also been improved. Especially when an animal is attacked and takes too much damage, it tries to flee. This may require a quick reaction if you want to kill the animal.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Small animals will still try to flee and it will now be more difficult to kill them.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]General Fixes[/b][/p][p]Various smaller bugs have been fixed to improve the gameplay experience and stability.[/p][p]If you have any questions or feedback, let me know! Thank you for your support and have fun with the game!

notes.title: Improvements to First-Person View, Weapons, and Animals!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Community,[/h2][p]I have just released a new update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Character:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The first-person view has been overhauled, so there should no longer be any clipping issues where body parts appear cut off or the arms start to fade in and out.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A future update will further improve the movements in the first-person perspective. For a while now, the camera has not been freely movable, which suppresses the wobbling in the first-person view. This change was made based on feedback from the community, who reported feeling dizzy during fast movements.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Overall, the gameplay experience in the first-person perspective should now be more pleasant.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Weapons:[/b][/p][list][*][p]All weapons and items have been realigned to fit better with the character and no longer appear misaligned.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]One-handed weapons have also been reworked to enable more realistic hit animations. Previously, some animations when striking would pass through trees or rocks. This has now been fixed, so hits are simulated more realistically.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Animals:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The AI of the animals has been further adjusted and bugs have been fixed. For example, wolves triggered a wrong animation when they started running. Now, animals like hares and chickens react by fleeing when you get too close, instead of just wandering around aimlessly.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Wolves and bears will now flee when you inflict damage on them. After a certain point, they will flee.[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]There will be another update to fix further animal issues.[/b][/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]General Fixes[/b][/p][p]Various smaller bugs have been fixed to improve the gameplay experience and stability.[/p][p]If you have any questions or feedback, let me know! Thank you for your support and have fun with the game!

notes.title: A few personal words & feedback welcome!
notes.content: [h3]Hello Community,[/h3][p]I'd like to address you briefly today, not with an update, but with a few thoughts about the game, its development, and the feedback from the community.[/p][p]Since the beginning of 2021, I've been developing this game as a solo developer with passion, patience, and constant improvement. There are regular updates, on average every two to four weeks, with new content, bug fixes, improvements, and performance optimizations.[/p][p]Community feedback also actively contributes to development, much of which has greatly improved the game. [b]At this point[/b], I'd like to thank everyone who has contributed constructively![/p][p][/p][h3]Review & Request to Previous Players[/h3][p]I know there have always been ups and downs over time, and yes, there are decisions I might have made differently in retrospect, but unfortunately, I can't undo. I can only look forward and move on.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What's going on with the reviews?[/b][/p][p]I've been observing the development of the reviews with mixed feelings for some time, especially because some statements contradict each other.[/p][p]Opinions vary. But I find it difficult to objectively assess the review status.[/p][p]I'm constantly thinking about how I can improve the game without deviating from my core idea. KeepUp Survival is intended to remain a [b]simple survival sandbox base-building game[/b], open and without fixed specifications.[/p][p]There were no fundamental [b]gameplay changes[/b] that could significantly impact perception, just improvements: content-wise, visually, and through bug fixes.[/p][p][b]Since March 2023[/b], however, the review ratio has significantly worsened, and honestly, I can't explain why. Don't get me wrong, it just feels like all the updates have done little to improve the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/b98bcdfacf83e284a37920f2f14aaa5176f39d9c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]How do you currently perceive the game?[/b][/p][p]I'm interested in your opinion, honestly: What do you like and dislike? And what do you think about the current review trend?[/p][p]Of course, there are still open areas to improve, such as the first-person mode or visual aspects; I'm aware of that, and I'm working on them. But none of that prevents you from actually playing or restricts important features.[/p][p][/p][h3]Your honest feedback[/h3][p]Some of you may have written your review at a time when the game was in a completely different state.[/p][p][b]If you like[/b], feel free to take another look; a lot has changed. Maybe your impression is completely different today, maybe not.[/p][p]But: [b]Your honest feedback really helps me.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for your time, your interest, and for every piece of feedback that helps move KeepUp Survival forward.[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/264aee71e06da86486948ace5e79e42d190fc722.png"][/img][/p][p]In Discord you have the possibility to follow the development and ask questions. From now on you also have the possibility to enter the mine behind the big mountain.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/fe845443a441e6102aace5bd7b06e321813c8ece.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Ruin[/b][/p][p]The ruin has been completely redesigned and enlarged, you now have a new entrance, but the atmosphere has also been revised here.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/0b2cb2b2e68ada2c07dce75183ed187c6b487994.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/721bd56829e01781fb3b2de47fc6b568b73d7385.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/59e2a98f3d1ae2bc8436d2570d4f00ef9e8fc82d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Street lighting[/b][/p][p]In the small village behind the ruins, the streetlights have been removed and lamps have been installed on the houses instead.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Environment & lighting[/b][/p][p]Small adjustments have also been made here to make the shadows more prominent, the colors are slightly more accentuated and the bloom effect has been slightly reduced.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Headlamp[/b][/p][p]The brightness has been increased slightly as it was quite dark.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Loot[/b][/p][p]Due to an incorrectly set loot, one or the other loot opportunity was removed from the level too quickly. For example, an apple lying around. From now on, it remains lying around until you pick it up. However, this only applies to placed loot, things that you drop yourself disappear after a certain time.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Standing torch[/b][/p][p]The brightness of the standing torch has been increased so that it can provide more light.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bootcamp[/b][/p][p]Some changes have also been made here, both visually and in the options for testing items. notes.title: GPU Bug Fixed & Lost Island Rework
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Community,[/h2][p]We just released a new update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Info[/b][/p][p]Since many individual changes were made and the GPU bug was also fixed, it is recommended to go in-game -> Main Menu -> Settings (Help) and perform [i]Clear[/i] once. If necessary, also perform [i]Reset[/i] in the video settings in-game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Game[/b][/p][p]KeepUp Survival game files have now been further reduced, so that less disk space is used – around 4 GB less.[/p][p]Additionally, other internal things were changed, which makes this update quite large.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Graphics Settings[/b][/p][p]More FPS settings have been added, which you can now select.[/p][p][/p][p][b]GPU Bottleneck Fixed[/b][/p][p]After a long wait, the GPU bug has now been fixed. This bug caused unnecessary GPU load, which led to poor frame rates.[/p][p]You should now be able to reach around 120+ FPS with Ultra Settings on the recommended hardware without limitations.[/p][p][/p][p][b]GPU Usage[/b][/p][p]Additionally, GPU usage has been reduced. However, keep in mind that depending on the hardware and settings you use, your hardware will be challenged accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]GPU VRAM[/b][/p][p]Additionally, GPU VRAM usage has been greatly reduced to make it possible for weaker hardware to run the game properly. Work is still ongoing to reduce usage as much as possible.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lost Island Rework[/b][/p][p]As announced in the news, Lost Island is receiving a small rework. In this update, large changes to the castle are included. The current castle was completely removed and replaced with a new one, along with nearby small houses.[/p][p]A mine has also been added, where you can find many stones to harvest.[/p][p]Also added are structural changes to large rocks, now visible across large parts of the map to make everything more visually appealing. Wooden stairs for climbing and new paths have also been added.[/p][p]Additionally, lifeless bodies can be found in certain areas of the map, meant to highlight a bit of the story of Lost Island. Even though KeepUp Survival is a sandbox game, it still needs a small story. In a future update, I plan to leave a hidden clue – follow this clue and you’ll learn more.[/p][p]The horse you can own has been relocated and can now be found near the castle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/f5c2436760df06c4f9619820b241cf35b2155a51.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/12f5dae8b95f153db55f0ba646a5232e4d38b3c3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Further Changes[/b][/p][p]Further changes to the crafting stations and the sulfur area were planned for this update, but I won’t release them yet. I prioritized the performance improvements and wanted to provide them as quickly as possible.[/p][p]In the next update, more changes to Lost Island Map will be released.[/p][p][/p][p][b]General Fixes[/b][/p][p]Various smaller bugs have been fixed to improve the gameplay experience and stability.[/p][p]If you have any questions or feedback, let me know! Thank you for your support and have fun with the game!

notes.content: [h3][b]Hello Community,[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Today I would like to share some good news about performance improvements and news about Lost Island.[/p][p][/p][p]A lot has already been done to improve performance, but so far the effects have been minimal. Quality has also had to take a back seat from time to time.[/p][p][/p][p]KeepUp Survival had an intense internal GPU bug that was so difficult to track down that it seemed almost impossible to find the problem properly. Even new versions of the engine didn't have the desired effect at first.[/p][p][/p][p]However, after much deliberation, I decided to take a bigger step and switch to the latest engine version in order to carry out further tests.[/p][p]And that's exactly what fixed the GPU bottleneck bug![/p][p][/p][p]Sometimes in development you have the strangest things where you keep asking yourself: what was it again? that's the way it is.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]I can now say: it runs very well![/b][/p][p]Even older computers will be able to play the game properly again with the upcoming update.[/p][p][/p][p]With Ultra Settings + TSR you can now achieve over 130 FPS (without limitation) on Lost Island, and on the Mountain Map it's even over 170 FPS.[/p][p][/p][p][b]GPU utilization used to be a tricky issue.[/b][/p][p]Here, too, the values are now very good: with an FPS limit of 60 FPS, the GPU load is only 50 % to 55 %.[/p][p]Of course, if you want to use higher FPS, you will have a correspondingly higher load - everyone should be aware of that. As it currently stands, it is perfectly tuned.[/p][p][/p][p][b]VRAM usage has also been optimized:[/b][/p][p]In order to reduce the memory consumption of the graphics card, I have reworked many textures.[/p][p]Now they usually only use up to 3-4 GB (a little more depending on the situation).[/p][p]My goal remains to keep the game playable for older systems.[/p][p][/p][p][b]News about Lost Island:[/b][/p][p]Lost Island is also currently receiving a small rework.[/p][p]With the upcoming update, there will be more new buildings, including a quarry.[/p][p]The large castle will also be completely renovated and given a completely new look.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Another feature planned for the upcoming update:[/b][/p][p]You will no longer be able to simply mine sulphur (sulfur) in the future, it will be necessary to carry a gas mask with you to do so.[/p][p][/p][p]At this point, many thanks again to Steam user & streamer [url="https://www.twitch.tv/kredoxtv"]Kredox[/url], who gave me this idea![/p][p][/p][p][b]You still don't have to worry about your savegames:[/b][/p][p]Your saved game data will of course be retained and can still be loaded, even if some new features and changes are added to the game.[/p][p][/p][p]The changes to the crafting stations will also be included in this update (as already announced in the penultimate update).[/p][p][/p][p][b]More information notes.title: Trading Cards, Multiplayer, Improvements and Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Community,[/h2]

We have just released a new update.

[h2]Trading Cards and Badges[/h2]
KeepUp Survival now officially includes its own set of trading cards (up to 10), badges, and additional content such as backgrounds and emojis. [b]These will become available over the next few days.[/b] [url=https://help.steampowered.com/de/faqs/view/70F3-F690-1013-237F]Learn more about trading cards[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/017447aef73347cc6071d0573fa2d4cca94c4dda.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/8f7f74e891ea3ccdda3decc1d7370533e7c788ac.jpg[/img]

One of my other games, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1843710]PURGE - Three vs Blood[/url], has also received these trading cards. Unfortunately, other games from us are currently excluded from these trading cards.

[h2]Lootboxes[/h2]
It has been reported that lootboxes and items were floating in the air. This issue occurred after an update and has now been fixed. The main reason for the floating lootboxes was that the objects, such as furniture, on which the lootboxes were placed were not displaying correctly.

If you notice anything else, please let us know.

[h2]Flashlight[/h2]
After the last update, the headlamp could no longer be used. This issue has now been fixed.

Note: To use the headlamp, you simply need to have a flashlight in your inventory. You can now easily activate the headlamp without holding the flashlight in your hand by pressing the "L" key.

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
Multiplayer is back in the store! It was temporarily hidden for new players due to some issues. We're still working on improving stability and the overall experience.

- The transmission in multiplayer has been improved to make the transmissions more stable, but it still needs to be observed whether these improvements remain stable in the long term. Due to a small error, too little bandwidth was allocated to the clients that joined the host, which caused synchronization issues as not enough data could be transferred quickly enough. Additionally, the connection timeout has been increased to prevent the connection to the host from being prematurely interrupted.

- Player names are now displayed above each character. Your own name is hidden during gameplay to avoid obstructing the view of your character. However, a follow-up update is planned, as we discovered a small bug after the release that causes names to display incorrectly.

[h2]Helicopter[/h2]
After the last update, you could no longer land your helicopter on your own platforms. This issue has now been fixed.

[h2]Reload Bug[/h2]
There were two minor reload bugs with major impact. The issue occurred when the player either opened the paraglider or jumped into water while reloading. In both cases, the character would get stuck in a loop, making it impossible to perform any further actions.

[h2]Network Error[/h2]
When connecting to an existing session, the connection may occasionally be lost, resulting in a network error. In such cases, the session you were trying to join could no longer be found. This issue has now been resolved, you should be able to rejoin the session without needing to restart the game.

[h2]General[/h2]
The ESC key now also closes the inventory and the map overview.

[h2]General Fixes[/h2]
Various minor bugs have been fixed to improve overall gameplay experience and stability.

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to let me know! Thanks for your support and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Important Information About the New Update! Controller, Backup, Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Community,[/h2]

We have just released a new update. Unfortunately, this update is quite extensive as some structural changes have been made.

[h2]Important:[/h2]

With this update, it is necessary to delete certain files. These files cannot simply be overwritten; otherwise, the game will not recognize the changes.

We have integrated a useful tool that can be found under Settings -> Help. There, you can clear the cache and temporary files as well as create savegame backups.

Clearing the cache and temporary files can be helpful if you encounter issues after an update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/ab8f4536bb934dc71d4ed2c9c624cbb392248453.jpg[/img]

[b]Instructions:[/b] First, download the latest update (Ver. 1.30.03.25), start the game, go to the settings, and perform the deletion. Then close the game, restart it, and reset your keyboard settings. After that, you can configure your settings as usual.

[h2]Controller Support:[/h2]

Based on frequent requests, we have improved and expanded controller support. You can now rely mostly on the controller and are less dependent on a mouse and keyboard. The keyboard is only required for text input.

The controller progress is currently about 80%, and further updates are needed to complete it.

There is still a minor conflict in the code that slightly restricts menu navigation in the main menu and in-game menu when using a controller. However, you should not experience any issues while playing.

The controller button mappings are displayed in the HUD, partially for the most commonly used inputs under Settings -> Inputs.

Please let us know if anything does not work as expected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/8f522e6deeade07043b98877b01564c5ba189165.jpg[/img]

[h2]HUD Icons:[/h2]

The HUD icons have been adjusted for controller use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/0d9121405490b7afd18a6a1013c3d4a04dd4c948.jpg[/img]

[h2]Collisions:[/h2]

After receiving reports about invisible collisions on the map, we conducted a review. It turned out that objects were displayed during development but were not visible to players in the game. This issue has been fixed. Additionally, minor adjustments have been made to trees, objects, and vehicles.

[h2]Languages:[/h2]

Further adjustments have been made in all languages.

[h2]Boats:[/h2]

Following reports that boats were not appearing for the return journey, this issue has been fixed.

[h2]Dynamite:[/h2]

By request, dynamite has been added to the "Tools and Weapons" workbench.

Other requests have not been forgotten and remain on the To-Do list.

[h2]Vehicles:[/h2]

The jeep has received a minor performance adjustment, and both male and female characters now have improved seating positions in vehicles. The issue where vehicles would be thrown around when colliding with trees has also been fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/65e32d7f0e6098803e8895f6a6981694006e234e.jpg[/img]

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to let me know! Thanks for your support and enjoy the game!

notes.title: A New Chapter Begins: A Big Project Unveiled!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Community,[/h3]

[b]I have some exciting news to share with you![/b] First, I want to emphasize that I have always worked as a solo developer on all of my games and have always relied on the support of the community to make everything possible. A huge thank you to all of you!

I continue to primarily work on "KeepUp Survival," but I have also developed smaller games like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1843710/PURGE__Three_vs_Blood/]PURGE - Three vs Blood[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2218460/Bunny_Guys/]BunnyGuys[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2965380/Relaxing_Simulator/]Relaxing Simulator[/url]. Unfortunately, these small projects haven't gained the recognition I had hoped for, but maybe you’d like to check them out!

"KeepUp Survival" is one of my projects with ups and downs. Despite all the challenges, it continues to move forward. The transition from UE4 to UE5 initially set the development back quite a bit, but thanks to your support, I was able to quickly address the problems that arose. I also want to remind you that updates for "KeepUp Survival" will continue to be released every 2 to 4 weeks as usual, though there may be occasional delays.

[b]I hope you continue to enjoy "KeepUp Survival"![/b]

[previewyoutube=GVc0rjS55lU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What is "KeepUp Survival"?[/h3]

It’s a base-building and adventure sandbox game where players can design their survival strategies in an open world according to their own preferences.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1524630/KeepUp_Survival/

[h3]First Insights into Something New![/h3]

Through my experiences on Steam and within the community, the growing competition, and the incredibly difficult task of maintaining visibility, I decided, after much consideration, to develop a game that would push my limits. About a year ago, I started working on "Return: Unknown," and at first, it was hard to believe in the project, even though over 140 users had supported the idea of me sticking to it. After two months, I put it aside because the idea just felt too big, and I feared it wouldn't resonate with the users. As an indie developer, I face challenges that big studios often don’t, and unforeseen events can affect the development process! However, thanks to your feedback and the messages from users in the past months who encouraged me to continue the project, I picked up the development again about four months ago and would like to show you the first insights now!

"Return: Unknown" is one of my biggest and most ambitious projects, and it’s distinctly different from everything I’ve done before. As a huge fan of survival games, I’ve never found a game that offered exactly what I envisioned. Now, I’ve made it my goal to use my personal favorites as inspiration: the movie *I Am Legend* and the games *Tom Clancy's The Division* and *The Forest* – all these elements flow into the development of "Return: Unknown."

[h3]My Goal with the Development of "Return: Unknown"[/h3]

With this new development, I aim to exceed my own expectations and create a gaming experience that goes far beyond my original ideas. My goal is to offer an immersive and realistic survival experience that truly captivates the players of "Return: Unknown." The game will differ significantly from "KeepUp Survival" and my other projects – both in terms of gameplay mechanics and overall structure and experience.

In the upcoming teasers, you’ll get your first glimpses of the still very early alpha version. Even though the game is still in its early stages, I want to give you the chance to take a look and hope that you’ll enjoy it!

[previewyoutube=ED6VTuwx7mg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The World of "Return: Unknown"[/h3]

Dive into a post-apocalyptic world where a global virus has wiped out civilization. The once-thriving metropolis of Manhattan is now controlled by infected and rival survivors. You fight for survival, hunt animals and infected, build a shelter, and gather valuable resources.

Explore the ruined city, dense forests, and abandoned villages while you make your way through this dangerous, open world.

[h3]Special Features of "Return: Unknown":[/h3]

[list]  
[*][b]Various Game Modes:[/b] Experience the game in single-player mode, multiplayer, or with up to 32+ players on your own dedicated servers.  
[*][b]Traditional HUD:[/b] In this game, you will see very few HUD elements, the focus is on using instruments to monitor your vital signs.  
[*][b]Bartering:[/b] Bartering plays a central role and allows you to acquire items that may help you survive.  
[*][b]Survival Instinct:[/b] Manage hunger, thirst, exhaustion, and even organ failure as you defend yourself against the dangers of the world.  
[*][b]Building and Crafting:[/b] Use resources to craft weapons, furniture, and safe shelters.

notes.title: Update Details & Changes
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Community,[/h2]

A new update has just been released. Here are the details:

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[b]Incorrect Reflections:[/b] On water surfaces, whether in the sea or a pond, incorrect reflections of the environment were generated. This issue has been fixed.

[b]Collisions:[/b] Over the course of updates, small issues with collisions have crept in, causing objects like small bushes or flowers to completely block the character. This has also been fixed.

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[b]Main Menu:[/b] A small visual adjustment has been made to the main menu.

[b]Game World:[/b] Improvements have been made to the visual presentation, and bloom effects have been added to enhance the overall look. Graphical adjustments were also made to tone down the overwhelming green-on-green effect, especially on Lost Island, in order to highlight other elements.

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[b]Overhaul:[/b] A larger section behind the big mountain on Lost Island, where the mine is located, has been reworked due to issues with vegetation (trees and bushes). As development progresses, additional areas for looting will be created.

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]

[b]Framerates:[/b] Lost Island continues to be analyzed for issues causing frame rate drops. Further adjustments have been made to improve frame rates.

[h2]Issues[/h2]

[b]Ghosting:[/b] Ghosting occurs when artifacts appear while selecting items such as an axe or in the shadows of trees. This issue is caused by TSR usage and originates from the engine itself, which we have no direct control over. We recommend switching to TAA if the ghosting effect is too distracting. This is a known issue that is being worked on.

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to let me know! Thanks for your support and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Improved Graphics Settings, Multiplayer Fixes & Storage Box Changes
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Community,[/h2]

I want to inform you about a new update that has just been released. Here are the details:

[h2]Graphics Settings[/h2]
From now on, you can use AMD Anti-Lag and Nvidia Reflex. However, it is advisable to use these features with caution, as they are still new to the game and might cause complications.

AMD Anti-Lag can be used together with AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution. However, during our tests, some issues arose when both features were used simultaneously. It is recommended to use either Anti-Lag or AMD FSR individually to avoid potential problems.

Therefore, I recommend trying out the feature first and checking whether it works optimally on your system.

[b]Note:[/b] Nvidia users can also use AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution, but not in combination with Nvidia Reflex. Currently, there is no further information available regarding this.

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]

[b]Animation Issues:[/b] Problems with animations in multiplayer mode have been improved. Specifically, the synchronization of fist punches between players has been fixed.

[b]Climbing:[/b] Issues with the climbing animation and the failure to execute climbing for teammates have been resolved.

[b]Collision:[/b] A collision issue that allowed players to climb invisible obstacles has been fixed.

[h2]Storage Boxes[/h2]

Small additional changes have been made: When dismantling or destroying storage boxes, campfires, and other objects, the contents will now spawn in a small container. Users need to collect or relocate the contents of this container if they wish to keep them. Please note that this spawned container is not permanently saved and will disappear after some time.

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to let me know! Thanks for your support and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Enhanced Performance, New Features, and Adjustments
notes.content:
Hello Community,

I would like to inform you about a new update that has just been released. Here are the details:

[b]Overhead[/b]
On the Lost Island Map, there have been recurring significant performance drops, the cause of which was unclear for a long time. The issue has now been identified, and initial improvements have been implemented. Further optimizations are already in progress to further improve performance.

A part of the improvements is already available. If you're playing on Ultra, you should now expect 60-80+ FPS. I recommend limiting the frame rate to 60 or 90 FPS to relieve the load on your GPU.

If this isn't enough, you can enable FSR in the game. This can significantly improve the frame rate, potentially even doubling it.

[b]Main Menu[/b]
There was also a minimal performance drop here, which has now been completely resolved.

[b]Cooking[/b]
You can now cook mushrooms, tomatoes, potatoes, bananas, pumpkins, and carrots. More cooking options are already planned.

Previously, potatoes and carrots could be consumed directly, but now you will receive more food and water through cooking.

[b]Converter[/b]
The "Trash Converter" has been renamed and is now available as "Converter."

With this, you can now extract more items and automate many processes. For example, you can convert old clothes into yarn or potatoes into seeds for the garden. Screws and nails can now be converted into Rubbish. A full list of items that can be converted is available in the main menu in the database.

[b]Companions[/b]
The companions (Beagle, Wolfdog, and Leopard) have also been overhauled. Optimizations were made to further enhance performance, as the companions were often loaded unnecessarily when they weren’t visible.

[b]Animals[/b]
All animals now have a new logic, similar to the companions. Animals are now handled differently as soon as they leave the camera's field of view. Specifically, animations are stopped, and tick rates are adjusted to improve performance. These changes should help display a larger number of animals simultaneously in the game.

[b]Boats[/b]
The boats, as a means of transport, have also been revised. A new logic has been implemented that changes how boats are loaded and improves performance. In future updates, this overhaul will be further optimized so that boats will be smoother and more pleasant when approaching and arriving.

Additionally, the horse has also been adjusted to improve performance.

[b]Languages[/b]
Adjustments have been made to all languages.

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to let me know! Thanks for your support and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Camera, Companions, and Performance Improvements
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Community,[/h3]

I wanted to inform you about a new update that has been released. Here are the details:

[b]Player Camera:[/b]

I have disabled camera shake while running, as many of you found it uncomfortable.

[b]Companions:[/b]

The companions (Beagle, Wolfhound, and Leopard) have been revamped. It was especially important to me that they no longer block the camera view when they are in an unfavorable angle to the player.

Additionally, I fixed a bug that allowed players to climb an invisible collision on the companion.

From now on, the button you need to press to make your companion appear or hide will be displayed in the bottom left of the screen. Some of you were confused when the display disappeared, so I’ve improved this. Note: If no button is shown in the bottom left, you currently do not have a companion.

[b]Achievements:[/b]

I made a few adjustments, especially with the repair achievements. Previously, you could only earn the repair achievements by repairing your house. Now, repairs to tools and weapons also count.

Screws and nails are now counted individually. For example, if you find 10 screws at once, they will be counted as 10 units.

[b]Performance[/b]

Further performance improvements have been made. On the Mountain, Tropical Island, and Red Desert maps, the frame rates were already within a balanced range, but with additional changes, the performance has been further enhanced.

Lost Island, on the other hand, still has issues with frame rates, despite many factors that should contribute to a significant performance boost, which, for unexplained reasons, has not yet achieved the desired result. A slight improvement has been made, which can also be doubled with FSR, but my goal is to bring these frame rates into a balanced range even without FSR.

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to let me know! Thanks for your support and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h3]Hello KeepUp Survival Community,[/h3]

I’m excited to share that another update has been implemented, bringing additional improvements and changes.

Last update: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1524630/view/4597700312703971166

[b]UnStuck[/b]

UnStuck is now executed using the Enter key and applies to both the character and vehicles.

[b]Character[/b]

A bug was introduced that was triggered by using the horse. This prevented proper climbing after using the horse. This bug has now been fixed. From now on, there should be no more issues in this regard.

[b]Character Animation[/b]

The eating animation was not executed correctly; this has now been fixed.

[b]Weapons – Reload and Scope[/b]

An animation bug that occurred when climbing and reloading simultaneously, leading to an infinite loop, has been fixed.

An additional scope has been added. Previously, you could craft a holographic scope but couldn’t use it. It is now usable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/f1176d7c055cafef5a60191b10228545db636791.jpg[/img]

[b]HUD[/b]

Some additional hints for HUD hotkeys have been added.

[b]Headlamp[/b]

Many didn’t realize that the flashlight could be used without equipping it, as long as it was in the inventory.

From now on, a prompt will appear in the bottom right corner when you have a flashlight in your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/ddd135c6b3739fc110bf3c933feb0141dfca8203.jpg[/img]

[b]Paraglider[/b]

When using the paraglider in combination with a wall, the character would sometimes attempt to climb. This issue has now been fixed.

[b]Helicopter[/b]

When entering the helicopter, the weapon is now holstered and no longer visible.

Collisions have been adjusted, as the character could unintentionally climb onto the helicopter.

Hotkeys can now be hidden while flying (Key H).

A display issue in the first-person view of the helicopter has been fixed. This issue occurred when entering the helicopter in first-person mode and then switching to third-person view.

An UnStuck prompt has been added.

[b]Vehicle[/b]

There were instances where the store box was lost when driving off. This has now been fixed. Please note that this box does not have a save option.

The vehicle now has a feature that makes a decision for exiting when overturned to prevent falling through the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/7ecd16aa9c49e7354e0291dc3d51bd422fb2f7b8.jpg[/img]

[b]Items[/b]

The appearance of collectible stones in the open world has been changed to make it easier to distinguish which stones can be picked up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/f97e0f9b8bea466d53a65f0d42c59ab79f229b24.jpg[/img]

[b]Animals[/b]

Collision settings for all animals have been adjusted. The introduction of the climbing feature caused unintended effects, allowing players to climb on animals. This problem has been resolved.

Collision settings for companions have also been updated.

Additionally, several minor issues have been resolved and adjustments made.

notes.title: Current Review Situation
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

I’d like to address the current review situation of my game. As many of you know, it’s a sandbox survival game with base-building elements that has consistently been rated between "Mixed" and "Positive" overall.

Recently, however, an unusual pattern has emerged: There has been an increase in negative reviews from players with only 0.2 hours of playtime (about 6 to 20 minutes) who often refund the game shortly after purchasing – particularly during the 80% discount sale when the game was priced at 2 dollars. Many of these reviews mention bugs but remain vague without providing specific details. Even when I directly ask for clarification in the reviews, I receive no responses.

Of course, there will always be players who don’t enjoy the game – which is perfectly normal. However, the current pattern raises some questions.

This situation has made me and some players wonder, as I’ve received messages from people who are puzzled by the sudden surge in negative reviews and can’t quite understand it. I want to emphasize that I take reviews very seriously and always try to address feedback to help or improve the game. Supporting the community and continuing to develop the game is very important to me.

Perhaps this is just a temporary phase, but I must take it seriously. As an indie developer working alone, such phases can have significant consequences, as a game often struggles to recover from them.

Maybe it’s something in the game itself, maybe there are misunderstandings, or perhaps it’s just not a game for everyone. In any case, I am very interested in understanding what I can do better. Your constructive feedback is incredibly valuable for the continued development of the game.

If you have been playing the game for a while and have any thoughts or suggestions, I would greatly appreciate it if you could share them. Any kind of feedback is valuable and helps in further developing and improving the game.

Thank you for your support and interest in my game. Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable in improving and advancing the gaming experience. I appreciate your patience and engagement!

notes.title: Improvements and New Features
notes.content:
[h3]Hello KeepUp Survival Community,[/h3]

I’m excited to announce that another update has been released, bringing additional improvements and changes.

[list]
[*] A helicopter has been added.
[*] The flashlight no longer wobbles when running.
[*] The stance and carrying position of the torch have been improved.
[*] You can now climb over small and large obstacles.
[*] The jump animation has been reworked.
[*] The overall posture of the character has been optimized.
[*] Animation transitions have been made smoother.
[*] Adjustments have been made to the first-person view (more to follow).
[*] Upon request, the camera position while riding the horse has been raised slightly, as there were occasional issues with blocked visibility. Improvements have been made.
[*] Certain elements of the HUD, such as the interaction display, are now hidden when using the horse or paraglider.
[*] The paraglider sound has been adjusted so that it now gradually increases during use instead of playing immediately at full volume.
[*] The vehicle camera has been fixed, and the issue with the camera twisting has been resolved.
[*] The starting positions on Lost Island, Red Desert, and Tropical Island have been reworked.
[*] The crashed plane has been added to Red Desert and Tropical Island.
[/list]

[h3]Optimizations[/h3]

Due to poor performance, particularly on Lost Island, adjustments were made. Unfortunately, these did not yield the desired results, so only parts of the performance improvements have been implemented. More will follow.

The current focus is on balancing the workload between the GPU and CPU. At the moment, the GPU is handling most of the work.

Many are wondering why the performance isn’t meeting expectations. KeepUp Survival is based on the current UE5 engine, which is designed for the next generation. Unfortunately, optimizations to improve performance don’t always go as planned and often don’t bring the desired results.

To counter this, FSR 3 was introduced in a previous update, which doubles the framerate, allowing for a smoother experience on older hardware systems.

[h3]Data Restructuring[/h3]

Adjustments have been made to better sort and prioritize data. This is intended to help reduce load times and improve performance.

These changes will allow future updates to be managed more efficiently and will also reduce data shifting on Steam.

[h3]Gamepad[/h3]

Due to high demand for full gamepad support, I am working on fulfilling this request. Unfortunately, this is not going completely smoothly. The main issue currently is implementing full controller support, which is being hindered by the drag-and-drop feature. For unexplained reasons, certain functions aren’t being adopted as expected. Forcing drag-and-drop with the gamepad makes the functions work as desired but causes issues with the mouse.

I wanted to highlight this issue to show that I’m working on it and striving to introduce this feature.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

Numerous other small bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Improvements and New Features
notes.content:
[h3]Hello KeepUp Survival Community,[/h3]

We are pleased to announce that another update has been carried out, bringing additional improvements and minor changes.

A particularly important innovation affects all current and future players, regardless of their hardware: thanks to AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 3.

To ensure that these features can be used smoothly, it is important to reset the graphics settings once. Any changes to the graphics settings should be followed by a restart to ensure that the settings are properly applied.

[h3]Performance Boosts Thanks to FidelityFX Super Resolution[/h3]

To optimize performance, you can now use AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 3, or "FSR" for short, in the graphics settings. This option is available to both AMD and Nvidia graphics card users.

By enabling FSR on Native AA, the frame rate has already been doubled.

[b]Optimal settings for maximum performance:[/b]

For the best performance on Ultra settings, we recommend enabling FSR along with native AA and a sharpness setting of 0.5. Optionally, you can also set shadows to medium for further improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/39afea99cb94f74fae93786493e4f0009b3f0877.jpg[/img]

[b]A screenshot with these settings shows about 55 FPS with TSR on Ultra.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/c6b3436f1f24500a716b771dd80d0d7ba6b31b07.jpg[/img]

[b]A screenshot with these settings shows about 110 FPS with FSR (Native AA) on Ultra.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/f9aeedff690b2e8e2c75b5d9b18ebee51452b21b.jpg[/img]

[b]Additional Feature: Anti-Aliasing[/b]

A new anti-aliasing option has been added to improve image quality and make edges appear even smoother. (FXAA, TAA, MSAA, and TSR)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/b25acb5ea9747508173c264e5b7dc2b02e840451.jpg[/img]

[h3]Graphics Improvements Related to FSR[/h3]

Due to the earlier switch from UE4 to UE5, there were some issues that needed to be fixed. The graphic representation also did not reach its desired potential. Thanks to fixing a bug, the graphics now look sharper and clearer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/b0f530b3700d21d9af81df8e094dc20bf3af3db5.jpg[/img]

[b]General Performance Improvements[/b]

Many aspects have been revised to improve performance. If you still want to get a bit more performance, set the shadows to medium. The differences in representation are minimal, but it helps improve frame rates.

[h3]Further Improvements and Bug Fixes[/h3]

[b]Object Highlights[/b]

From now on, certain objects will be highlighted to help you see them better and more clearly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/ae80a63538ef8c938f0eb8bb4a49300b5d4edea5.jpg[/img]

[b]Oxygen[/b]

Your character can no longer dive indefinitely. On the left side of the screen, you will find an oxygen display. When it runs out, your character takes significant damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/a2bd6f2acc1d7629ccf8736e59d76cfc5ad6ba53.jpg[/img]

[b]Sprinting[/b]

There were two small bugs with sprinting that have been fixed. On one hand, the display continued even after stopping sprinting. On the other hand, it was possible to sprint indefinitely by pressing W and A/D simultaneously. Both issues have now been resolved.

[b]Paraglider[/b]

A small error in the paraglider that affected lateral movements has been fixed. You can now glide through the air smoothly again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/103eb09d9bcbb9cc832c5f2b441b7db6cf683e28.jpg[/img]

[b]Vehicles & Horses[/b]

It was previously possible to drive vehicles underwater easily. This is no longer possible. When you reach a certain water depth with a vehicle, your character will automatically get out. The vehicle despawns after about 3 minutes and reappears at the last save point, including any loot. These 3 minutes give you the opportunity to retrieve your loot from the vehicle if desired. The same applies to horses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/82fe12276b691f460e97f2d857fc33a80c162628.jpg[/img]

[b]Horses[/b]

The camera control has been slightly improved, making transitions smoother. The camera has been fixed, leading to better control behavior.

Animation errors and jumping issues have been fixed.

Further improvements are planned to make the horse more dynamic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/1f3640c6e1313fecf35afad9e44578d50c8dc8ab.jpg[/img]

[b]Vehicles[/b]

When getting into the vehicle, there was an issue where the character was not completely removed. You could see the shadow and weapons hanging in the air and hear the character's footsteps. This problem has now been resolved, so such errors should no longer occur.

[b]Character[/b]

The camera control has been improved, making movements smoother and more pleasant. This leads to an overall better gaming experience.

[h3]Controller Support[/h3]

Due to numerous requests, we have improved and adjusted the controls for vehicles, horses, and now also the paraglider. You should now be able to play these with your controller. If the control is still not quite optimal, please let us know.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

Numerous other small bug fixes have been carried out.

[h3]If you've read this far, thank you for your attention![/h3]

And you are the person to first know that a homemade helicopter is in the works. You can use it for exploration, and transport options are also planned.

notes.title: Ongoing Work and Improvements - Announcement of the Next Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello community[/b],

I would like to update you on the current work being carried out. I hope you are looking forward to the upcoming update.

This update includes various fixes and improvements, as announced in the last news.

In particular, adjustments have been made to the character and horse to ensure smoother movements.

The issues with the horse, such as jumping and animation errors, which were reported to me, have been fixed.

Additionally, underwater riding or walking with the horse has been corrected and will no longer be possible in the upcoming update. When you enter the water, you will automatically dismount, and the vehicle will disappear after 3 minutes, reappearing at the last saved location with your inventory intact.

The horse will exhibit similar behavior, although we are considering introducing swimming for the horse.

The control of the paraglider has also been fixed and will be included in the upcoming update. You will once again be able to fly smoothly above the clouds.

Another idea that was communicated to me, but often seen as a bug, was the ability to breathe underwater. I had never implemented a function for this, but it will be available in the upcoming update. You will no longer be able to dive indefinitely and will need to surface for air.

The character sprinting has also been improved. Previously, it was possible to sprint indefinitely by pressing two keys in a specific way. This is no longer possible.

The graphics of the game look quite good on Ultra settings, but I was never fully satisfied. I discovered a bug that occurred during the transition from UE4 to UE5, which could not be corrected easily. Various adjustments were made to solve this issue, and now the graphics look much clearer and more pleasant.

As already mentioned, I am aware that the current performance is not optimal, particularly due to the spawning of animals. I am continuing to work on fixing and mitigating this problem.

Additionally, as mentioned in previous news, FSR (FidelityFX Super Resolution) will be added to help improve performance on older computers.

[b]Please bear with me a little longer and continue to enjoy KeepUp Survival.[/b]

notes.title: Updates
notes.content:
[h3]Hello KeepUp Survival Community,[/h3]

Today, another update has been implemented, bringing additional improvements and minor changes.

Due to repeated misunderstandings regarding saving and loading in the game, some adjustments have been made. I hope that these changes will lead to a positive outcome.

[b]Here's a brief explanation:[/b] When dying in the game, players lose their inventory, which then needs to be retrieved. Many players attempted to bypass this by simply reloading the game. However, this led to the loss of the inventory as no spawn point was set and the inventory could not be restored as it was not collected by the player as intended and was not saved.

I have observed that some Twitch and YouTube streamers also believed that saving was not functioning. This led to frustration, refund requests, and negative reviews. This also deterred many others from playing because who wants to play a game where saving doesn't work? I hope now that this update provides positive prospects for the future and eliminates any misunderstandings.

[b]The following improvements have been made:[/b]

- You can now easily reload your game and retrieve your old inventory from the last save point.

- Please note that this only applies to the "Normal" game mode. In "Hard" mode, you are required to retrieve your inventory, or else it will be lost.

[b]Further changes:[/b]

- I have been informed that certain items were spawning in the wrong loot boxes. These have now been corrected.

- Additionally, all languages have been revised again to accommodate some text changes.

- Saving and using the admin menu in Boot Camp has been disabled.

- A bug was found in the achievements, now all achievements should work fine.

- The XP allocation has been checked again, problems were found when killing animals. Here the XP award was not counted and is now fixed.

notes.title: Saving and Loading Savegames
notes.content:
[b]Dear Community,[/b]

Today, I'd like to address the topic of saving and loading game progress. It's unfortunate that players occasionally encounter difficulties when trying to load their game saves.

However, in the upcoming videos, I aim to show you that saving game progress poses no discernible challenges. There are important points to consider, especially in the event of in-game death, which I'll elaborate on here.

When you die in the game, it's crucial to retrieve your inventory. Simply reloading the game to restore your inventory is not advisable.

[b]Here's what happens when you die in the game:[/b]

[list]
[*]The game progress is automatically saved.
[*]You'll respawn at your last secured respawn point.
[*]If you haven't set a respawn point, you'll start in the starting zone.
[*]Your inventory remains at the location where you died.
[*]The lost inventory remains in place for a certain amount of time.[/list]
[b]Some players might attempt to exit the game without saving and loading the game state. Here's what happens in that scenario:[/b]
[list]
[*]The respawn cannot be loaded because the player didn't save, resulting in no respawn point being available.
[*]The lost inventory is no longer present at the location where the player died, as it despawns after a limited time.
[*]Reloading a game state causes the lost inventory to immediately despawn.[/list]
[b]Notification:[/b]

A notification will also appear, reminding you to retrieve your inventory. Afterwards, you'll respawn either at the starting point or at your last respawn point that you've set. However, if you attempt to load the game state without saving beforehand, you'll start at the beginning.

As you may often gather from the reviews, there are mixed opinions. If you have concerns, questions, or problems, please feel free to reach out to me via the CommunityHUB or Discord for assistance.

I'm always willing to help anyone facing issues. It's important to me to maintain communication with players to continuously improve the game and the player experience. Perhaps the game simply lacks additional information to better inform users.

I hope I've been able to clarify the game's save process somewhat.

As a developer, it's my goal to continuously improve the game and shape it according to the community's needs. Your valuable suggestions allow me to plan new features, optimize existing ones, and refine the player experience.

Today, another update has been implemented, bringing additional improvements to the "Create Game" menu and minor bug fixes.
