notes.title: KeepUp Survival: Early Access to Triumph - Official Launch is Approaching!
notes.content:
[b]Hello dear "KeepUp Survival" community,[/b]

It's hard to believe how far we've come! Three years of hard work as a solo developer, and now "KeepUp Survival" is on the verge of its official launch. The journey has been filled with challenges but also incredible support from the community.

Honestly, it's overwhelming to see how many of you have immersed yourselves in the world of "KeepUp Survival" and made it your own. Not only have reputable online magazines like [url=https://www.4players.de/4players.php/spielinfonews/PC-CDROM/41588/2197180/]4Players[/url] and [url=https://mein-mmo.de/neues-survival-spiel-steam-deutscher-entwickler-keep-up/]MEIN-MMO[/url] taken notice, but also small yet incredibly dedicated streamers like [url=https://youtu.be/LTaVWaIC5h0?si=mRR1b-BnWFWV1nXC]GameEdged[/url], [url=https://youtu.be/b8vr8E1CCi0?si=Q0SqsWSJEEPBds0R]TightRopeWalker[/url], and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pearlsplaytime]PearlsPlaytime[/url] have discovered and shared the game.

A special thanks to all the small streamers who invested their time and energy to bring "KeepUp Survival" into the living rooms of their viewers. Your support means the world to me, and I'm grateful for every minute you've dedicated to the game.

But that's not all: a huge thank you to all the players who have expressed their love for "KeepUp Survival" through bug reports and improvement suggestions. Your constructive criticism has helped continuously enhance the game, shaping it into what it is today.

I understand that "KeepUp Survival" may not be everyone's cup of tea. A simple survival game without complex features can sometimes be perceived as dull. However, I've learned that it's impossible to please everyone. Still, I give my best and stand by my vision.

For those of you who appreciate the simplicity and challenges of "KeepUp Survival," I thank you from the bottom of my heart. Your passion and dedication have turned this game into what it is today. Together, we've overcome setbacks and celebrated triumphs.

But that's not all! The development of "KeepUp Survival" continues with more content. Look forward to exciting expansions, different maps, and intriguing extras. Issues will continue to be addressed, and your ideas and wishes are always welcome. Although the journey so far has been successful, the best is yet to come. Stay tuned and anticipate the upcoming innovations that will shape the future of "KeepUp Survival."

Thank you for your ongoing support and for being part of this amazing journey. The official launch of "KeepUp Survival" is just around the corner, and I can't wait to experience this exciting milestone together with all of you.

[b]Furthermore, I wish you an extraordinarily entertaining experience on KeepUp Survival.
[/b]

notes.title: Updates and optimizations
notes.content:
[h3]Hello KeepUp Survival Community,[/h3]

Today, another extensive update has been released. As you may have noticed in the past few days, regular smaller and larger updates have been provided.

This latest update includes crucial bug fixes and a revision of the Lost Island Map. The two DLC maps have also undergone minor adjustments.

The Lost Island Map now features a new surface, accompanied by various optimizations to enhance the overall gaming experience.

Unfortunately, there are still issues with the frame rate on the Lost Island Map. I am actively working to optimize the framerates on this particular terrain.

Furthermore, various sound bugs have been addressed, and adjustments have been made to the magazine of one of the pistols to prevent it from sticking beside the weapon.

The muzzle effect on the weapons has also been slightly tweaked.

[h3]End of the Early Access Process[/h3]

I am considering concluding the Early Access process on February 26, 2024, while development continues as usual.

I chose February 26 as it marks the date when the game entered the Early Access phase.

Given that KeepUp Survival is a sandbox game primarily focused on base building and survival, we can confidently exit the Early Access process. The concept of sandbox gameplay should be familiar to most.

After the transition, as mentioned earlier, development will proceed as usual. Additional content, including the free map, will continue to be added.

[b]Issues after an Update?[/b]

Please note that you should only proceed with the following steps if you are familiar with the process, as each individual is responsible for their own actions.

[code]Delete this folder once: Config

This is located here: C:\Users\PC_NAME\AppData\Local\KeepUpSurvival\Saved\Config[/code]

This action will remove and regenerate all settings and entries of the game.

Additionally, we recommend clearing the Steam cache and performing a repair on the game.

notes.title: KeepUp Survival: Blossoming Changes!
notes.content:
[b]Dear KeepUp Survival Community,[/b]

I am excited to announce the exciting developments in KeepUp Survival! After intense work and based on your valuable feedback, I present the latest update. The update is substantial at 15 GB, but this is due to the reconfiguration of the engine.

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Before diving in, there are some crucial points to note that some users may need to address to avoid issues.
[hr][/hr]
Error Message: If an error message appears when starting the game, please check the freshness of your graphics driver. It is also possible that your system is outdated, as the game now relies on DX12, and older PCs may encounter issues. To play nonetheless, enter the following launch command in Steam: -DX11

Key Bindings: The issue with saving key bindings has been successfully resolved. However, some users may need to follow a specific step; otherwise, the game might not save key bindings correctly due to changes made. To fix this, please delete the specified folder, for example, by removing the file:

[code][b]Note:[/b] Make changes only if you know exactly what you are doing! Each user is responsible for their actions.[/code]

C:\Users\PCNAME\AppData\Local\KeepUpSurvival\Saved\

Deleting this folder will allow the game to regenerate files upon startup, and saving key bindings will then work as usual. This instruction applies exclusively to users who have owned the game for an extended period!

Farming System: Preparations went mostly smoothly, but not all possible plants have been integrated yet. Currently usable plants are listed below: Potato, Tomato, Corn, Carrot, Watermelon, Cucumber and Pumpkin.

[b]What to Expect in the Update:[/b]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Revised Farming System:[/b] The farming system has been adjusted to the day-night cycle, influencing your crop yields.

You can now craft the following items: UV light, heat lamp, small and large sprinklers. Manual water addition is done using untreated water! Additionally, you can now use fertilizer to increase yields.

Further improvements and adjustments will occur in the course of development!

[b]Greenhouses and Their Functions:[/b] Existing components allow you to build greenhouses that provide UV light and warmth to your plants even at night.

[b]Game Interface Improvements:[/b]
Minor issues in the HUD have been fixed, and the character preview has been improved for better clarity.

[b]Save Key Bindings:[/b]
Now you can save your individual key bindings. I recommend performing a key binding reset to ensure everything works smoothly.

If the reset still leaves the keys empty, follow the instructions above.

[code][b]Note:[/b] Currently, there may be cases where a reset leaves the keys empty. A solution to this problem is actively being worked on.[/code]

[b]Animal Functions (AI) Overhauled:[/b]
To enhance performance and improve gameplay flow, the AI has been reworked. The AI now reacts to how far you are. When you reach a certain radius, the AI is deactivated. If you exceed another radius, the AI is automatically removed from the game.

When you hunt an animal, it remains until you've harvested everything. However, if you move away, a timer is triggered. This timer ensures that the animal is removed from the game if you do not return.

[b]General Improvements:[/b] I have also fixed other minor issues in the game to optimize the overall gaming experience.

Work has been done to improve frame rates. Currently, there is a known issue on the Lost Island Map in the starting area at the farm, affecting frame rates significantly. Efforts are actively underway to address this problem. If you notice anything in this regard causing frame rate drops, please let me know.

Improvements and issue resolutions have also been made on Red Desert and Tropical Island.

The update will go live shortly. Stay tuned and look forward to experiencing these exciting new features!

Thank you for being part of the KeepUp Survival Community. Your engagement and feedback have played a crucial role in implementing these improvements.

Get ready for more exciting news and get ready to enhance your KeepUp Survival experience!

I hope this update significantly improves your gaming experience in KeepUp Survival. Have fun playing and exploring the new and improved features! Stay tuned; there are many exciting developments in the future!

notes.title: Update brings important multiplayer fixes and HUD improvements!
notes.content:
KeepUp Survival, an extensive update has just been made available. With important problem fixes and improvements in multiplayer mode, as well as other small adjustments, this update is a big step forward.

However, there may still be issues in multiplayer mode, as multiplayer is not yet mature compared to single player mode.

[b]Multiplayer improvements:[/b]
One of the standout features of this update is the resolution of multiplayer issues. This ensures that players have a smooth and enjoyable experience when playing with friends or against others. 

[hr][/hr]
[i]Currently, there is an issue in multiplayer mode where players cannot use their items as intended. However, these issues only affect teammates and not the host. It works reasonably smoothly in the first-person perspective, but repeated pressing is required in the third-person perspective. Another problem that has been added is the unreliability of hitting items. Work is still underway to get these issues back under control as soon as possible.[/i]
[hr][/hr]

[b]HUD misrepresentation fixed:[/b].
The display of the HUD in multiplayer mode has also been corrected. Now players can clearly see all important information without being bothered by unexpected display issues.

For example, the correct display of items that were not always shown correctly to the teammate to create things like an axe.

[b]Minor issues fixed:[/b]
In addition to the major multiplayer improvements, minor issues have also been addressed to make the game smoother and more bug-free overall. This means that players will have an even more enjoyable experience.

[b]Loot Boxes in their proper place:[/b]
Another highlight of this update is the correction of Loot Boxes that were previously out of place in unexpected places. Now they are back in the right places!

I hope that this update will significantly improve your gaming experience in KeepUp Survival. Have fun playing and exploring the new and improved features! Stay tuned, there are many exciting developments in the future!

notes.title: KeepUp Survival - Multiplayer
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community[/b],

I hope you are well and enjoying your time on KeepUp Survival.

As some of you already know, KeepUp Survival includes an unofficial multiplayer mode. However, this mode has faced significant problems since the engine was changed.

In the past, I've had to make numerous repairs to fix a variety of minor issues. Currently, there is still a persistent problem in multiplayer mode, especially related to the use of axes or torches. It frequently occurs that the client has difficulty picking up these items. They float in the air or simply do not work as intended.

After extensive research, I was able to narrow down this problem and am determined to pursue it further. Interestingly, this problem does not seem to occur on the two smaller cards. If I am wrong and you experience this problem there as well, please let me know.

On the main map, Lost Island, I have noticed that this problem is particularly common when approaching sea water, which is indeed quite strange. At higher elevations, however, this problem does not occur. It seems that several factors overlap here and trigger this problem. If you have had any other experience in this matter, please let me know about it as well.

Furthermore, I would like to tell you in another news how things are going with the Early Access title KeepUp Survival.

notes.title: KeepUp Survival
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Community, I hope you are doing well and having fun with KeepUp Survival![/h3]
With this news I would like to provide a small summary for existing users and future visitors.

[list]
[*] [b]Game Trailer[/b]
[/list][hr][/hr]
First of all, I would like to present you the new small game trailer of KeepUp Survival: 

[previewyoutube=jFGn-eZz9Pg;full][/previewyoutube]

[List]
[*] [b]Discount[/b]
[/list][hr][/hr]
There is also a 25% discount currently being offered on KeepUp Survival!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1524630/view/3680051934771750107

[list]
[*] [b]General[/b]
[/list][hr][/hr]
- [b]Changes:[/b] KeepUp Survival has some time ago been implemented fundamental and important change. It included the new UE5 and important changes. Unfortunately, the transition did not go smoothly and was very bumpy. This led to additional work messing up the schedule.

- [b]Info:[/b] Due to the great demand, full controller support is planned, but you will have to be patient at the moment. The partial controller support is also still a bit bumpy due to the changeover and still needs to be adjusted and improved.

As another thing, the AI and performance are currently being further improved, and the planned human AI is also still in development.

Due to the change from UE4 to UE5, some problems had to be fixed and some things had to be rescheduled. The elimination of the problems had priority.

- [b]Marketing:[/b] During development, it is also important to do marketing. Unfortunately, KeepUp Survival is no longer promoted on Steam like it used to be. This means that, unfortunately, KeepUp Survival is no longer recommended.

Right now, I'm running my own promotional efforts to even be found. But as an indie developer, it's not easy to implement the best advertising strategies. 

I hope that this will change for the better in the near future.

- [b]Updates: [/b]KeepUp Survival will continue to receive regular small to major updates every 2 to 4 weeks.

Important updates are also carried out as usual at any time if required.

Link: Updates that are in progress can be viewed here. However, the list may change constantly. https://steamcommunity.com/app/1524630/discussions/21/3414307711413107053/


- [b]Multiplayer mode:[/b] This mode has not been officially available for some time due to various problems. This mode is now only unofficially available.

[b]**[/b]The game is explicitly advertised as a single player mode.

In development, single player mode is prioritized without regard to multiplayer mode. Multiplayer games often require double and triple the work of a single player game.

Considering the problems with multiplayer and the increasing competition that offers much better multiplayer games, I think my decision is the right one.

However, multiplayer mode will continue to be developed, but there will be changes to enable multiplayer mode, "activation will be required". Hereby I want to make sure that users are better informed that this mode may contain issues and is provided on an experimental basis. Firstly, to better inform users about it, as mentioned before, and secondly, to mitigate the bad reviews about this mode.

notes.title: Update #75 - Ver. 0.7.5b - 23 / Part 2 from 2
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community[/b], KeepUp Survival is now running on the UE5 since 14.5. 

Today the 2 part of the update #75 has been released. As many have noticed, the transition from the old UE4 to the new UE5 did not go smoothly and brought many problems and at the same time bad reviews and completely messed up my planning process.

I was more concerned with fixing problems than I was with the update I had planned.

This update #75 part 2 is mostly about bug fixes and I had to postpone the planned changes, to an upcoming update.

Here I have a small summary of how big the problems were: All sounds were wrong to unassigned, in all components the collisions were shifted, many textures were not loaded, many codes were wrong. In all existing maps some objects and effects were not loaded anymore. Translations had to be reworked.

At this point again a thank you to the users ( Amelara, Saelwinn, Ragnar, mickMankind, Loftie and many more ) who sent me the problems as fast as possible. 

Problems and changes that are not finished yet:
- Farming system bug

- Provide changes to the Lost Island map
- GamePad improvements
- Multiplier
- Improvements to weapons and projectiles
- Fix other bugs caused by the change
And much more.

notes.title: Update #75 - Ver. 0.7.5b - 23 / Part 1 from 2
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community[/b], KeepUp Survival is now running on the UE5. This update #75 will be released in 2 parts.
[hr][/hr]
But first, I want to thank my community again for making this all possible and sacrificing their time to help me find problems faster. Your wishes and ideas with me stehts share. This is not a matter of course and I thank you for it. 

It is always nice to see users returning who have been with KeepUp Survival since its release. Many have changed their reviews to positive, which also surprised me a lot. Thanks again for that!

And I hope we can achieve more good years together to make the game something better.
[hr][/hr]
- The first part includes the complete overhaul of the main engine, especially other changes like the main menu and the overhaul of the AI, sounds, graphics and more. It also includes other changes, but they will be fully effective only with update #75 part 2.

- Therefore, there may be some limitations in functionality, for which I ask for your understanding. Unfortunately it is not possible for me as a single person (developer) to make so many changes in this short time and work error free.

- The update now also includes the possibility to determine the seasons yourself or to let them run fully automatically.

- Changes to the farming system have been made, but will only be usable in part 2.

- Please do not use old game saves, the changes are enormous, so old game saves might just contain problems. For all further updates you can continue to use the game saves as usual.

[b]Part 2 contains: [/b]
- The revision of the map Lost Island
- Improvements to weapons and projectiles
- Human AI

- Zombie Dismember

notes.title: News - Transition to UE5
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community[/b], I have decided to update KeepUp Survival to UE5 in the near future. 

The preparations are already done and there are also many changes in the works, such as a new main menu and pause menu, corrections to the key bindings and a revision of the Lost Island map with more houses and a partial revision of the landscape. There will also be changes in collecting trees and stones. You'll also get more freedom to decide how you want to play. For example, like multipliers. The animal system will also get a change, as it was announced in the RoadMap.

When exactly the change will be, I can't say at the moment. But I hope that it can be implemented in the next few weeks. Unfortunately, not everything always works out the way you want it to, which often slows down development. 

I would like to mention again that there is only one developer working on this game. And I ask for your understanding that not always everything works smoothly at the first go. I try very hard to fix problems and respond quickly to questions about the game. 

I also hope to create more visibility for the game with the upcoming changes and thus hope for better feedback. 

[b]Info[/b]
[hr][/hr]
[When the new version is available!] During the modification and deployment, many files are exchanged. This means that everyone will have to completely reload the game once. It is also recommended to clear SteamCache once before performing this download.

It is also recommended to reset all settings in the game.

An announcement will be made when the new version of KeepUp Survival is available for download in the coming weeks.

[b]Savegames[/b]
[hr][/hr]
I always try to keep the game saves up and running, which has always worked well so far. I will do my best to keep the old saves working after this change.

[b]Wishes and Ideas[/b]
[hr][/hr]
Wishes and ideas are always welcome. This is to help make the game better and more enjoyable for users.

notes.title: KeepUp Survival - RoadMap 2023
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Community,[/h3]

I would like to give you a sneak peek with some already known information!

[b]About KeepUp Survival[/b]
[hr][/hr]
KeepUp Survival is a sandbox game set in a natural and post-apocalyptic environment where your task is to survive. The game is largely based on the community's requests and ideas.

Feedback from the community is very important to build upon. Wishes and suggestions are also welcome. Supporting videos and sharing information can help the KeepUp Survival community grow as it grows.

The game offered is an indie game, you can read about what exactly an indie game is here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1524630/discussions/21/3597842130158305321/.

Please note that KeepUp Survival is an (Early Access) and may still contain issues. Thank you

[previewyoutube=_M9cT-ku4zk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]News published about KeepUp Survival on the Internet![/b]
[hr][/hr]

2022 [url=https://mein-mmo.de/neues-survival-spiel-steam-deutscher-entwickler-keep-up/](MEIN-MMO) KeepUp Survival News[/url]

2021 [url=https://www.4players.de/4players.php/spielinfonews/PC-CDROM/41588/2197180/4Players_PUR-Neu_auf_dem_Marktplatz_PC-Vollversion_von_KeepUp_Survival_von_Wittes_Studio_Early_Access.html](4players) KeepUp Survival News[/url]

KeepUp Survival has also been supported by small and big YouTubers like [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLX9-ScSif_3uycnX-HlbXbEkFV07YorKa]GameEdged[/url] and [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLhk2InOhK1bcinHiX2VCDOfeQtFsfnhUb]Kage848[/url]  in the form of videos.

[b]Other functions[/b]
[hr][/hr]
I would like to add more features to the game that would allow the user to further customize the game to their needs.

Specifically multipliers, for more loot or changing the life energy of the animals or zombies.

Ideas: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1524630/discussions/11/

[b]Implementation of the submitted wishes and ideas![/b]
[hr][/hr]
It is always nice to see that ideas and wishes are submitted, but it is also important to realize that not every wish can be implemented. Unfortunately, negative experiences have already been made here because a wish was not implemented or would like to be introduced. However, I also find it a shame that this is also used as a reason to give the game a bad review.

[b]Summary[/b]
[hr][/hr]
[b]- Free Zombie DLC (expansion)[/b].

As announced in the old RoadMap, there will be a free zombie DLC. This is now available since October 2022.

KeepUp Survival is a game that is not about killing zombies. Due to frequent requests, a free zombie DLC has been made available. This allows the user to play against zombies.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096140/KeepUp_Survival___Zombie_Expansion/

With this expansion you can now play against zombies. It reduces the number of animals to make survival more difficult and the threat of zombies is increased.

[b]- Male and female character[/b].

As previously announced, a male character was also going to be added. This has now been implemented to give you the choice between male and female characters.

The male character was released with update 71#.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1524630/view/3664279192936676179

[b]- Summer/Winter cycle[/b].

In the meantime, winter has also become part of KeepUp Survival. Since some time you have the possibility to choose between winter and summer.

However, as a further function, it is planned to have this change automatically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/d9b2d55f0a6160050c268b1aaf26eb5c0b4b4581.png[/img]

[b]- Animal system[/b]
Unfortunately, the animal system is a thorn in the side of many or is misunderstood? Major changes are planned, aging of animals as well as natural death may be removed from the game. Also the slowing down of the animals when they take damage. Unfortunately I receive bug reports and even bad reviews very often regarding this. 

The animal system is not perfect yet and still has its problems, but I actually wanted to score points with users with these extras. For this reason I have decided to remove these extras if necessary.

[b]- UE4 to UE5[/b].
KeepUp Survival will be updated to UE5 in the near future. Also, many changes are in the works, such as a new menu, problem fixes and a revision of the Lost Island map.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1524630/view/3692428039477079174

[b]- Farming system improvement[/b].
As announced, the farming system was to be revised. This change has now been made and has been available to users for quite some time.

In addition, the farming system will be further improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/9a375e4c51e138ea21449d684049cd5c31ac3313.png[/img]

[b]- Map system[/b]
In January 2023, a new map system was introduced to improve the overview. There will be further improvements here as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/d6847aa10181c320d799db31181c4f2c3b004ee4.jpg[/img]

[b]- Graphical improvements[/b].
Another thing that has been done is graphical improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/a286fd47949a3155b061ef28b4e45518130825e7.jpg[/img]

[b]- BootCamp[/b]
In February 2023, a small BootCamp was added to the game, but it is still being improved. 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1524630/view/3644011092473494967

[b]- Locomotion options[/b].
The fans on the map are also particularly helpful, as they should make it easier for you to move faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/66f4b5bc67afb798242829ab1ba2915e828efbbf.jpg[/img]

[b]Further planning[/b]
[hr][/hr]
- Better balancing
- Vehicles
- Merchants to exchange items
- More building possibilities
- More animals to tame
- More creatures
- More animal types
- Other enemies (Pandits)
- Lost Island expansion (small towns and more small villages)
- Zombie DLC improvements
- General DLC's (Desert Map and Tropical Island) improvements and enhancements
- General fixes
- General optimizations
- Implementation of requests and ideas submitted!

[b]Witte´s Studio Games[/b]
[hr][/hr]
As a small indie studio, I also work on other small games. However, the main development is KeepUp Survival. The small games that are developed are outside of KeepUp Survival's regular working hours. 

All updates and news about KeepUp Survival can be found here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1524630.

Updates are made every 2 to 4 weeks and provided as update news. Smaller updates will be provided without notice.

This update contains some updates, especially a change of the benchmark test at the first start of the game.

Users with older systems had problems with the first start of the game, here a small benchmark test is performed to make the optimal settings. On older systems this often didn't work out so well and in the worst case led to a crash of the game.

Now the test is no longer executed automatically and is started with medium settings. An automatic benchmark test can be found under the graphics settings, but is not recommended for older systems and manual entry of the graphics settings is recommended.

If you find any problems, please report them to me. This is the only way I can fix problems faster and improve the game.

[b]Important:[/b] 
- Remember that healing, eating and drinking are not so simple anymore. You have to take your food in your hand now and keep the mouse button pressed.

notes.title: News - Farming-System and Map-Overview
notes.content:
[b]Hello community[/b], I would like to remind you once again that you will always have the opportunity to receive information about the latest update, which is in preparation.

I try to keep the update list up to date, at least the important things that might interest a user. However, always remember that this list can change at any time.

[h3]Information and preparations [/h3]
[hr][/hr]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1524630/discussions/21/3414307711413107053/

I also want to share with you some news about the upcoming update.

[h3]Farming-System[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
It's about the Farming System, which I had disabled due to various issues, but is now being completely overhauled. 

You will have the possibility with the new farming system to watch the growth of the plants besides the usual harvest. There will also be plants that can harvest permanently. These plants can also die if they are neglected. 

UV lamps will also be used, which will require the current solar cells and batteries that can be found from time to time. There is also another glass roof that is also equipped with solar cells and UV lamps.

There is also a sprinkler system, so you do not always have to worry about it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/9a375e4c51e138ea21449d684049cd5c31ac3313.png[/img]

[h3]Map-Overview[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Another point to be revised is the map overview. After I read the reviews and ideas of some users that it would make much more sense not to show the map overview completely, but to have to explore the areas before you can see them on the map overview. I personally have to agree with that as well, it's also too easy at the moment, you can see where all the important points are to be found, whether it's iron or sulfur. For a new player it's not a challenge to find these spots, because it's already shown where you can find them.

Also, the animals are shown to you on the map overview and so is your teammate. If you set the game mode to hard, the animals will be hidden in the map overview. As further you can set several markers, these can also be provided with a text.

Planned was also a mini-map in the HUD, but this mini-map will not be available for the update yet. There I am not yet sure whether I will introduce something like that in the HUD.

[h3]Other:[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Remember that the upcoming update may contain issues that need to be fixed. Please inform me about it, only this way I can fix the problems faster and improve the game experience. Thank you

[b]Continue to have fun with KeepUp Survival.[/b]

notes.title: News
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community[/b], I would like to thank again all users who took the time to report problems in KeepUp Survival. Also, once again, a big thank you to the supporters who have provided videos for KeepUp Survival, for example.

Submitting issues gives me the opportunity to fix problems faster and improve the game experience and quality. 

Also, I want to mention again that I am an indie game developer, there is no team or whole studio behind it. I work here all by myself as an indie developer and the games I offer are indie games produced without financial support or dependence on other companies/publishers. These indie games are often small, mid-sized games that are usually of inferior quality and should not be equated with large companies/publishers. https://steamcommunity.com/app/1524630/discussions/21/3597842130158305321/

I will continue to do my best to satisfy users. Of course, I won't be able to make everyone happy with my games, but I'll try my best.

I also want you to know that if you have any questions, feel free to ask and I will try to answer as soon as possible. You can reach me here in the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1524630/discussions/]CommunityHUB[/url][/b] or in [b][url=https://discord.gg/8zyKXj9SDr]Discord[/url][/b]. Please don't send me friend requests on Steam, I know you mean well, but follow me on my social media instead. This helps me grow immensely as well.

Also, I have been thinking about offering a demo for KeepUp Survival. I want to give players the opportunity to try out the game in a small way before they decide to buy the game. This should also help me get feedback faster and also reach the right users who are interested in this game.

My first test run with a demo I have now applied to my other game [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1843710]PURGE - Three vs Blood[/url][/b]. If you are also interested in trying it out. Just have a look.

[b]Maybe you also have ideas what this demo of KeepUp Survival should be able to do? [/b]

[b]Continue to have fun with KeepUp Survival.[/b]

notes.title: KeepUp Survival - RoadMap - About me!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Community,[/h3]

I would like to give you a little insight into the future with some already known information and answer questions about me that I have been asked often.

[b]About KeepUp Survival[/b]

KeepUp Survival is a sandbox game set in a natural and post-apocalyptic environment where your task is to survive. The game is largely based on the community's requests and ideas.

KeepUp Survival is currently being developed by (1) a developer who is trying to make a nice small and simple survival game. Feedback from the community is very important to me so I can build on it. I also welcome requests and suggestions. Supportive videos and information sharing can help the KeepUp Survival community grow.

This game is an indie game, what exactly is an indie game you can read here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1524630/discussions/21/3597842130158305321/

Please note that KeepUp Survival is an (Early Access) and may still contain issues. Thank you

[h3]About me![/h3]

I often get inquiries from users about where I'm from and how I do it all. So I would like to tell you a little bit about me here.

[b]Where are you from?[/b]
I'm from Germany, have been a family man for 15 years and am now 36 years old. My dream has always been to do something better, to have something of my own, to stand on my own two feet and be independent. I think many people have this dream, but to achieve it, you have a hard road ahead.

[b]What are your interests?[/b]
My interests have always been in computers, graphics, (clan/game) web design and also game development. I've taught myself everything in a roundabout way over the years. But that's what I love to do and would do again and again. From that, I built my dream and started my sole proprietorship.

[b]What are you working on right now?[/b]
I'm currently developing KeepUp Survival, which has been in (Early Access) since February 26, 2021. It's not a title that blows you away, and not everyone likes it, but it appeals to a small part of the Steam community, which I'm very happy about. I really hope that it will become more and that I will gain some notoriety with my work. I'm definitely very grateful for the small streamers and users who have always supported me along the way and continue to do so.

[b]What are your tasks?[/b]
My job consists of developing games, writing news, advertising, creating videos for the community, designing graphics, and general tasks that come with being a sole proprietor. In addition, constant support via the CommunityHUB, Discord, and email is often at the forefront of my mind, which takes up a lot of my time. My work hours are often over 10 to 12 hours a day, 7 days a week.

[b]Do you still have a private life?[/b]
To be honest, no. I try to achieve something with my work and what I have built up. Of course, I make time for that too, but work comes first. When you work independently, you always have the fear that the ship will start to sink. I think you understand me!

[b]Do you work on other games as well?[/b]
Yes, I work on other games as well. But the main development is KeepUp Survival, I only work on these games outside my working hours or when I need a clear head. 

[b]News published about KeepUp Survival on the Internet:[/b]

2021 [url=https://www.4players.de/4players.php/spielinfonews/PC-CDROM/41588/2197180/4Players_PUR-Neu_auf_dem_Marktplatz_PC-Vollversion_von_KeepUp_Survival_von_Wittes_Studio_Early_Access.html](4players) KeepUp Survival News[/url]

2022 [url=https://mein-mmo.de/neues-survival-spiel-steam-deutscher-entwickler-keep-up/](MY-MMO) KeepUp Survival News[/url]

[b]If it convinced you, follow me![/b]

- YouTube [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCxCCohvCAKiskQSrduGVPvg] https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCxCCohvCAKiskQSrduGVPvg [/url]
- Twitch [url=https://www.twitch.tv/flitzpiepeoo] https://www.twitch.tv/flitzpiepeoo [/url]
- Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/Flitzpiepe_o0]https://twitter.com/Flitzpiepe_o0[/url]
- Steam Franchise [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/40590839] https://store.steampowered.com/curator/40590839 [/url]
- Discord [url=https://discord.gg/8zyKXj9SDr]https://discord.gg/8zyKXj9SDr[/url]
- Facebook [url=https://www.facebook.com/KeepUpSurvival] https://www.facebook.com/KeepUpSurvival [/url]

[h3]RoadMap[/h3]

As previously announced, there will be a free zombie DLC.

KeepUp Survival is a kind of game that is not about killing zombies. Due to frequent requests, I have decided to offer a free zombie DLC. This will allow the user to play against zombies.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096140/KeepUp_Survival___Zombie_Expansion/

This DLC allows you to play against zombies. It reduces the number of animals to make survival more difficult, and the threat of zombies is increased.

Currently you can add this expansion to your wishlist, I can't give an exact release date at this time.

[b]Male and Female Character[/b]

I have now also decided, as previously announced, to start this implementation and allow you to choose between male and female characters.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1524630/view/3370400292099373062

Again, I don't want to give an exact date yet because it's a lot of work to implement these things. I'm trying to implement a lot of things quickly, but please be patient.

[b]Unreal Engine[/b]

The game is currently based on Unreal Engine 4 and will be moving to Unreal Engine 5 in the future. Again, unfortunately, this is not done overnight, nor is it mandatory to make this change. But I want to let you know that I have thought about making this change in the future.

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
There will be a change in the multiplayer, the game KeepUp Survival was usually only developed as singleplayer and on demand more and more expanded to multiplayer.

In the future I will turn the multiplayer into a DLC, with this I want to make the users more aware that the multiplayer needs more work and can still contain bugs. 

This also allows me to get the main game out of the EA process faster. The EA process always has a lot of advantages for developers because you can always change a lot of things without getting in trouble later. The game will continue to be developed after the EA process.

[b]Summary[/b]

- Zombie DLC (expansion)
- Male and female character
- Better balancing
- More building options
- Further improvement of the farming system
- Summer/Winter-Cycle
- More animals to tame
- More creatures
- More animal species
- Lost Island expansion (small towns and more small villages)
- Change from UE4 to UE5
- General fixes
- General optimizations
- Implementation of requests and ideas submitted!

[b]Witte's Studio[/b] (@Flitzpiepe) wishes you a lot of fun with KeepUp Survival.

notes.title: KeepUp Survival - Problem Messages
notes.content:
Hello community, it's about reporting issues.

There are really only a small handful of users who use the support or report problems. Many who immediately access the rating system write after a short time that many things do not work. But look at how many users have played for hundreds of hours. Often it is things that players misunderstand or misunderstand. 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1524630/discussions/21/3414307711413107418/

Of course there are bugs and problems, but that's why you use the EA status as a developer. Early Access has the advantage for users that they can influence the game and share their wishes, ideas and problems with me during development.

While it's up to everyone how they submit their reviews, I also want you to take advantage of the support options before making a decision. With an EA title, this is very important so that issues can be identified and fixed more quickly. I always do my best to respond to reviews, even if I have limited ways to respond via reviews. I want to motivate users to use the forum and accept the help offered. I have often wondered if there is any point in responding to reviews anymore, since I can't motivate users to accept help.

You often read everywhere that developers don't give support, but I find that many don't want to accept support at all. 

Submitting a review seems to be done quickly, but for me it is a real setback to see again and again that no help is accepted and at some point I don't know how to help anyone else here if none is accepted. Of course my offered game has problems, but again I have to say I can't look into your systems to see if everything is working smoothly. Problems can lie with the customer or they can lie with the game. But without communication from both sides, you would never know.

I'm just a small indie developer from a small corner of Steam. I rely on the community, as do many other small indie developers. Without you guys, we wouldn't exist either. Reviews should be used consciously, whether good or bad. There are also users who use this system to ask their questions, here I would like to mention that as a developer you don't get a notification when someone submits a review. Each developer decides for themselves if they want to look at the reviews.

I just want to say, please use the support Steam and developers give you before making a decision. Thanks for reading!

notes.title: KeepUp Survival - News - RoadMap
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Community,[/h3]

First of all, a big thank you to my community who shares their ideas, suggestions and bugs with me every day.

And also once again a big thank you to YouTuber [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LTaVWaIC5h0&list=PLX9-ScSif_3uycnX-HlbXbEkFV07YorKa&ab_channel=GameEdged]@GameEdged[/url] who brought KeepUp Survival more into the spotlight. YouTuber [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tfG4AjomcmM&list=PLhk2InOhK1bcinHiX2VCDOfeQtFsfnhUb&ab_channel=Kage848]@Kage848[/url] has also taken the time to support this game in the form of YouTube videos.

Even the little YouTubers: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b1M7hLrgXTs&list=PLZ72tczm1VK7LY-kVsAHMDlGH289OmPAM&ab_channel=MrsFarmerJW]@MrsFarmerJW[/url] ,[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E4vx57Jkl8Y&list=PL5Sa6L1q5szo2ios5NmQKfhguqvLLWEOB&ab_channel=TightRopeWalker]@SoBo and TightRopeWalker[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dIpHQfSCidg&list=PLKlybz62zFLhK3p6aotlwmHVt3OVXgs9w&ab_channel=ManMeetsGamez]@ManMeetsGamez[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u6Kvy202yM0&list=PLAUXf05u-6AYYVTyR3Xg3evw_aAmqp0x6&ab_channel=Wanheda]@wanheda[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bM9le0kGgUM&list=PL7MVWJDBgMJhMy9jEzzVXP5AHOPSZUSSi&ab_channel=butchCassidy]@butchCa$$idy902[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JD2DIjsoOCA&list=PL2ufBnyPwgH0q5jpxQe8knWGMcGTVBQeu&ab_channel=Queenbee]@Queenbee[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e0cysnBNjCk&list=PLs2Y8fwNsGH0srXrfb850NUex9wOFBKEi&ab_channel=dieimwaldlebt]@dieimwaldlebt[/url] also a big thank you again.

I would like to say that something like this is not a matter of course, and I appreciate it very much. And I am very grateful that I have your support.

Thanks to your support, I also made it to the news page of [url=https://mein-mmo.de/neues-survival-spiel-steam-deutscher-entwickler-keep-up/]My-MMO[/url].

[h3]General:[/h3]

With this news I would like to address again some important points. And give you a little insight into the RoadMap. This is not all I show here, and there is still a lot to do. More will emerge over time together with the community, in which direction KeepUp Survival will continue to develop. KeepUp Survival consists mainly of the wishes of the community and will remain so. Of course you have to compromise and you can't fulfill every wish. Some know that I try very hard to answer many requests, many also know that I work alone on my developments. And I hope that you also have understanding for it, if sometimes answers can come too late. I always prefer the forum for support, here I also get notifications. 

[h3]RoadMap:[/h3]

[u]Miscellaneous[/u]
[list][*]The complete weather system will be reworked
[*]Enlargement and improvement of Lost Island
[*]Graphical improvements and optimizations
[*]Further improvement of the multiplayer mode
[*]Other means of transportation
[*]Better balancing
[*]More loot
[*]More recipes
[*]More building options
[*]Improved taming system
[*]Better animations
[*]More creatures
[*]More animal species
[*]Animals should be more dynamic
[*]Improve the farm system
[*]Reduce head bobbing in FP
[*]More small Maps
[/list]
Wishes and suggestions are always welcome.

[u]Provision of MOD's[/u]
[i]Important: The provision of mods or the intervention in any form in the game remains prohibited to users! MOD's have no priority here and are third priority, as the development of the game always comes first. MOD's are only provided by the publisher (Witte's Studio) for KeepUp Survival.[/i]

Some users have asked for MOD's, I was not quite sure, have now also decided to provide some extras as DLC's this way. Ideas and wishes are also welcome. The additional DLC's will be provided free of charge. 

Forum: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1524630/discussions/15/]DLC's General[/url]
Forum: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1524630/discussions/17/]DLC's Submit-Ideas[/url]

DLC to unlock special functions!
[list][*]This DLC is developed to unlock features that are not common.[/list]
Zombie DLC!
[list][*]With this DLC you have the possibility to play against zombies![/list]
Multiplayer possibly provide in form as DLC!
[list][*]The reason is that it needs some work, many may not read through the EA description. If I provide the multiplayer as DLC, there is a higher chance that users will read it.[/list]

[u]Provision of DLC's[/u].
Since the beginning of KeepUp Survival, it was planned to provide small maps and extras in the form of DLC's for free and for a fee. Some see it critically, others are happy about it.

Again, wishes and suggestions are welcome.

notes.title: KeepUp Survival - News
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community,[/b]

first of all, as always, a big thank you to my community for sharing their ideas, suggestions and mistakes every day.

[b]General:[/b]

With this message, I would like to once again address a few important points.

In case there are any problems, I have put together some instructions. 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1524630/discussions/10/]Guide English[/url]

If your problem could not be solved, you can use my forum or Discord for that. Please make sure that you post in the right channel, otherwise it can happen that you get wrong information for help. Also, it is the guarantor's imperative not to lose track of what is going on. Remember that this game is in the EA.

- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1524630/discussions/0/]Community HUB[/url]

- [url=https://discord.gg/xGHBzyBJtG]Discord[/url]

[b]Singleplayer mode:[/b]

There should be no major issues in single player mode. Of course, there may still be issues here and there, but that won't stop you from playing the game fully.

If you are using the single player mode, you can always transfer your score to a multiplayer mode. You can also switch back to single player mode.

When using single player mode, you will still be shown in the server browser unless you switch your single player to offline or are not connected to the Internet.

[b]Multiplayer Mode:[/b]

Multiplayer mode can have its issues here and there, but that doesn't stop you from playing through the game. 

It has often been reported that players have been kicked off the server. When you create a session, you should wait a moment for the session to fully load before other users join.

How fast your session loads always depends on the hardware, some load faster, others take longer. If your server is not loaded properly and someone wants to join, the server may kick them out.

Loading a save game is as dependent on the hardware as it is on the data stored. The more of it is stored, the longer it takes.

[b]Server Browser:[/b].

Some have wondered why so few servers are shown or why servers are closed.

Everyone can decide for themselves whether their session is open or password protected. Or if he wants to have it displayed in the server browser at all.

Full servers are automatically hidden in the server browser, which leads to the fact that only servers are displayed, which also have free seats.

[b]Contact:[/b]

If you have any problems, please use the contact options. Steam forum, email or Discord.

notes.title: KeepUp Survival - News
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community,[/b]

first of all, a big thank you to my community for sharing their ideas, suggestions and mistakes every day.

https://youtu.be/1JS7WGGfTug

[b]General:[/b]

I would like to address a few important points with this news and how KeepUp Survival will continue.

The upcoming update #44 will again bring something major, from some bug fixes to the reworking of the Lost Island map. You can always check out what's included in this update here, note that this list will be expanded and changed until the update is released.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1524630/discussions/0/3106892784341763850/]Community HUB / Information and Preparation[/url]

[b]Community:[/b]

The users and readers who don't know yet, this game (KeepUp Survival) is a 1-man developer project that integrates with the community. It is important to me that users know and respect this, unfortunately due to the size of the game it is often thought that there is a whole team behind it and it is responded to accordingly.

[b]Updates:[/b]

It is tried to implement many things quickly and make them available as an update. Usually not even 2 weeks pass and an update is available. It is not unlikely that errors can happen here. Also keep in mind that this is an Early Access game. What Early Access means, you can read here.  

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/earlyaccessfaq/?snr=1_5_9_]Early Access information[/url].

It has been discussed with the community to move the update times to 1 time per month. Important updates that could limit the game will still be done at any time. 

It is not to burden users so much with constant updates anymore, although it is very nice to always provide updates quickly. But experience shows that users feel very annoyed by it. 

[b]Problem messages:[/b]

I also receive messages that leave me speechless (nothing works, the game doesn't start, everything is buggy and glitchy).

There are some players who have played over 200 hours, even playing the multiplayer successfully. Of course, there can be problems in the (EA) process.

The community also often observes that players make handling errors and report it in the form of a bug. This is ok and can happen.

To counteract this, here is a German language Let's Playlist provided by the community. More Lets 'Play videos for KeepUp Survival will follow daily.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EoCXOXsQ_00&list=PL5Sa6L1q5szqkC-2vdGpOQztzq3t4YHbC&ab_channel=TightRopeWalker]KeepUp Survival - Let's Plays[/url]

[b]Problems after an update:[/b]

There have been reports of problems in the form of a crash in the game after an update. If it happens to them, it is recommended to clear the Steam cache and repair the game. Many users do not know and usually this is done fully automatically, as far as I know. However, from my own experience, I recommend doing it yourself.

Also pay attention to whether a download with the name (Steamworks) was queued, you should not ignore that and always install. Otherwise, there may be problems with Steam games. 

[b]Contact:[/b]

If you have any problems, please use the contact options. Steam forum, email or Discord.

notes.title: News - Updates - Lost Island
notes.content:
[h3]Now it's time for news again.[/h3]

First of all, I would like to thank all the users who support me, report bugs or even share their feedback with me. 

It's important to me that the community knows how much I appreciate them, the support that is always given. 

Some are obviously already puzzled why there is no update coming right now. I've delivered an update about every week since the Early Access launch on 2/26/2021, mostly in between, to improve many things. There have been about 25 updates that I have provided, and many smaller updates.

I think it always sounds great to do a lot of updates, but a lot of updates can be really annoying for players. 

Now I want to make a bigger, effectively important change, and in that regard, I don't want to provide an update now to prepare something bigger. 

The preparations that are being made are to give KeepUp Survival a bigger jump to get closer to what you want to achieve.

Here would be in bullet points a compilation of what is planned for the upcoming update and also currently in the works.

[list]
[*] The new map: Lost Island 
[*] Performance improvement
[*] HUD revision
[*] More information when collecting
[*] Better balancing
[*] Taming system
[*] Breeding system
[*] More animal species
[*] AI-Revision
[*] Improving the production of components
[*] More building possibilities
[*] And various trifles
[/list]

Now the question would be when the next update is planned. I know many are looking forward to it, but I must say it will take time. I also don't want to promise anything when it will be ready, but I am aiming to provide the update in the next few weeks. Below you will find the latest images that will enrich your imagination.

In the Discord and on Facebook respectively, pictures and information will be published every now and then to keep track of the current state of development.

notes.title: RoadMap
notes.content:
[h3]What all comes, I have compiled here in short form.[/h3]

What this game is about, I would like to briefly summarize here.

You are always on deserted islands that have been abandoned for several years. Accidents in underground laboratories have produced mutated creatures. You fight for your survival against hostile animals, creatures, human AI and other players.

You'll have the opportunity to adventure around the island to explore things and get to know the island better.

Right now it's not quite where it should be, but I'm committed to implementing everything quickly. However, it is also possible that I make mistakes.

[b]What is the current IslandMap about?[/b] This map is from EA-Start and is supposed to help make a lot of things better. However, this island will (eventually) no longer exist later, when the transition to the Lost Island Map is complete.

Wishes and suggestions are always welcome.

[list]
[*] New map Lost Island
[*] More maps (e.g. Canyon, Desert)
[*] Better balancing
[*] More building possibilities
[*] Taming system
[*] Breeding system
[*] Improvement of the farm system
[*] More creatures
[*] More animal species
[*] More human AI
[*] And much more
[/list]

notes.title: FPS problem and crash was found!!!
notes.content:
[h3]Good news for a problem that has been causing trouble for over 1 month![/h3]

After a long search the problem with FPS drops was found, the game KeepUp Survival normally has up to 120 FPS at Ultra Settings. Due to a problem in the engine, a FPS drop down to 60FPS and more was found. And this is huge, but work is being done to get rid of this annoying problem.

Also, it could happen that players with older graphics cards with DX11 could crash the game. This would disprove what some players have told me. 

[h3]And here again a big thank you to my players who regularly help me troubleshoot[/h3]

Until then I ask for patience. Continue to have fun

notes.title: Latest news about the development
notes.content:
[h3]The first 4 weeks, the first actual news since the beginning of Early Access.[/h3]

It was not the best start that was hoped for. All the more I was surprised by the helpfulness of very many users who supported KeepUp Survival during the debugging process.

As the sole developer of KeepUp Survival with very little sleep, a lot of work and a lot of community support, I managed to provide 12 updates with 41 bug fixes, 114 changes and 57 renewals in 4 weeks.

Thanks again to all users who supported me, for which I am very grateful. Providing bug reports or even feedback is very important to build on.

Some players have already noticed that this game is a bit different from conventional survival games and also wishes are gladly accepted and of course not all wishes can be fulfilled, what you have to respect please. 

[h3]What was the actual plan of KeepUp Survival before Early Access?[/h3]

I have been asked this question many times and I would like to answer it now.

The actual plan was to put yourself in the position of living alone on an island that was abandoned a long time ago. An endless game with the art to survive, build something and explore the island adventurously. So no big deal!

Due to the requests of PvP and PvE I have adapted to the community and implemented some things in this regard. 

[h3]What's next for KeepUp Survival?[/h3]

Next up are big changes and renovations:
[list]
[*]More content
[*]More build options
[*]Official MMO servers
[*]A performance friendly new map
[/list]
In addition, minor updates for bug fixes and changes will continue to be provided.
